title: The invite link forgets the invitation as soon as you sign in or sign up
steps: Signed out, open http://localhost:4601/join?code=NHUA1B
Tap "Sign In to Join" (goes to /login?from_url=...join?code=NHUA1B)
Tap "Create one", sign up with a new e-mail, type any 6-digit code, tap Verify
Repeat in a second browser but log in with an existing account (newbie@example.com) instead of signing up
expected: After signing up or logging in I am taken back to the invitation and asked to join "Thursday Whist".
actual: Both times I landed on /home with "NO GROUPS YET — Create a group for your whist circle, or join an existing one with an invite code." Nothing mentions the invitation. Only opening the link a second time, now signed in, shows the join dialog.
why_it_matters: "A friend sent me a link" is how most people will first meet the app. After the effort of signing up they are told they have no groups and are asked for a code they never typed. They have to guess that going back to the chat and tapping the link again will work.
evidence: Tool output after sign-up: OK tapped [2] button "Verify" → now at /home ... ## NO GROUPS YET
Tool output after login with an existing account: OK tapped button "Log in" → now at /home ... ## NO GROUPS YET
Browser storage before sign-up: base44_from_url = http://localhost:4601/join?code=NHUA1B ; after sign-up: base44_from_url = http://localhost:4601/home
suggested_fix: Carry the invite code through login, sign-up and e-mail verification, and open the "Joining <group>" step straight after. Show "You are joining Thursday Whist" on the login and sign-up screens while an invitation is pending.

title: After creating a group nothing tells you to add players, and the place to do it is at the bottom of Admin under the Danger Zone
where: Group home (/) after Create Group; /session/new; Pick the table; /admin
steps: Sign up, tap Create Group, fill in name and display name
Read the group screen: two empty states ("No Rounds Yet", "No Sessions Yet") and one button, START NEW SESSION
Tap START NEW SESSION, then Start Session (accepted with one player in the group)
Tap START ROUND 1
Open the Admin tab and scroll to find where players are added
expected: Right after creating a group the app says the next step is to add or invite at least three more players, and offers it in one tap.
actual: The group screen never mentions players. I created a whole session with only myself in the group. The first hint came three taps later on Pick the table: "This group has fewer than 4 players — add members in Admin first." It is plain text, not a link. In Admin the MEMBERS list and its Add button are the last thing on the page, below Group settings, Invite code and the red DANGER ZONE (Archive / Delete).
why_it_matters: This is the first thing every new group owner must do, and it is the hardest thing to find in the whole first-night flow. Scrolling past Archive and Delete to add a friend feels wrong.
evidence: Tool output on Pick the table: This group has fewer than 4 players — add members in Admin first. / [5] button "Start Round (0/4)" disabled
suggested_fix: On an empty group show a first-run step: "Add your players (you need 4)" with Add player and Share invite link buttons. Make the "fewer than 4 players" message a link to the members list. Move Members to the top of Admin and the Danger Zone to the bottom.

title: The scores are never explained where they are shown; the only help is an AI chat hidden in the menu
where: Session page, round page, New session form, menu -> Ask About the Game (/rules)
steps: Play one round: bids 4/3/3/4, tricks 4/2/3/4, Save Round
Read the result: Noa +26, Dana -10, Yossi +19, Michal +26
Try to find out why 26: tap the score, the round card, open the round page, open the player page
Open the menu and try "Ask About the Game"
expected: Somewhere next to the numbers the app says how a round is scored (made bid, missed bid, zero bid), or a visible "How scoring works" link.
actual: The round card and round page show only "bid 4 · won 4 | +26". Nothing is tappable for an explanation. The New session form explains only the penalties ("Classic = −10 per missed trick. Progressive = escalating penalty by miss size.") and not what a made bid earns. The only source is a chat assistant under the menu item "Ask About the Game", which is not linked from any score. With Progressive I saw −5, −10 and −15 for 1, 2 and 3 tricks off, which reads as a flat −5 per trick, not "escalating".
why_it_matters: The brief's question "what do the numbers mean" has no answer on any score screen. A scorekeeper is trusted only if the table can check its arithmetic; here they must guess that a chat exists and type a question.
evidence: Tool output, Progressive session: Dana♠ Spades | bid 5 · won 7 | -10 ; Yossi | bid 3 · won 4 | -5 ; after edit: Yossi | bid 3 · won 6 | -15
suggested_fix: Add a short static "How scoring works" sheet (made bid = bid² + 10, missed = penalty per trick, zero bid, renege) reachable from the session and round pages, and show the breakdown on the round page, e.g. "4² + 10 = +26". Reword Progressive with its real numbers.

title: One tap on an unexplained RENEGE chip silently takes 100 points from a player
steps: In step 2 enter tricks for all four players
Tap the grey RENEGE chip on Yossi's row (bid 3, won 3); it turns red, nothing else changes
Tap Save Round
expected: The screen says what RENEGE means and what it costs before it is applied, and asks to confirm or shows the penalty in the row.
actual: RENEGE sits on every player row with no explanation. Tapping it only changes its colour. After saving, Yossi, who made his bid, shows "-81" with a small "(reneged)" label. I learned that a renege is "Failing to follow suit; −100 penalty" only by asking the rules assistant afterwards.
why_it_matters: A curious or accidental tap on a word a newcomer does not know changes the standings by 100 points with no warning. That is exactly the kind of surprise that makes a table stop trusting the scorekeeper.
evidence: Tool output after tapping RENEGE: LISTING unchanged, but the page itself changed in a way the markup does not expose
Tool output after saving: Yossi(reneged) | bid 3 · won 3 | -81
Rules assistant: Renege: Failing to follow suit; −100 penalty.
suggested_fix: When RENEGE is switched on, show in the row "Renege (did not follow suit): −100" and the resulting score, or ask for confirmation. Add a one-line explanation the first time. Expose the on/off state to assistive technology.

title: The invite page does not say which group, and offers a new person only "Sign In"
steps: Signed out, open the invite link
Read the page
Tap the only button, "Sign In to Join"
expected: "Maya invited you to Thursday Whist" (or at least the group name), one line on what WhistMate is, and a clear choice between creating an account and logging in.
actual: The page says "YOU'RE INVITED — Sign in to join the group with code NHUA1B and track your whist nights." No group name, no explanation of the app, no About/privacy link. The button leads to "Welcome back — Log in to your account"; a first-time visitor has to spot the small "Create one" link. The sign-up screen then shows no trace of the invitation.
why_it_matters: A newcomer cannot tell whether the link is the right one or what they are signing up for, and is greeted with "Welcome back" on their first visit.
evidence: Tool output: # YOU'RE INVITED / Sign in to join the group with code NHUA1B and track your whist nights. / [1] button "Sign In to Join"
suggested_fix: Show the group name (and member count) on the invite page, the three benefit lines from the landing page, an About & privacy link, and two buttons: "Create an account" and "I already have one".

title: "Wins" counts a night that is still open, and the word is not explained in the standings
where: Sessions tab standings; session standings; Profile -> WIN RATE
steps: Play one round in a session and close it; start a second session and play a round, leave it OPEN
Read the standings on the Sessions tab
Open Profile and tap WIN RATE
expected: A win is counted only when a night is finished, and the standings say what a win is.
actual: With one closed and one OPEN session, standings showed "Noa 2 rounds · 2 wins" (after a further round, "3 rounds · 2 wins") and Profile showed "WIN RATE 100% · 2 wins". The tip defines win rate as "Share of sessions finished in 1st place", yet the open session is counted. In the standings "win" has no explanation; after round 1 Yossi had made his bid and showed "0 wins", which I first read as rounds won.
why_it_matters: The number contradicts the app's own definition, and a mid-evening leader is already credited with winning the night.
evidence: Tool output: [4] Whist Night | OPEN ... [5] #1 N Noa 2 rounds · 2 wins · +38 avg
suggested_fix: Count wins only for closed sessions (or label the open one "leading"), and write "nights won" instead of "wins" in standings.

title: Table words and marks on the round screens are not explained: UP/DOWN, Σ, the TRUMP dot, hierarchy, Down-Up
where: Landing page, New session form, Bidding (step 1 of 2), Results (step 2 of 2)
steps: Start a round and enter bids
Read the badge that appears ("UP · 14" or "DOWN · 10") and the line "Table UP"
Look at the TRUMP column: a faint dot on each row
Start a session with Advanced rules on and read the options under the suit picker
expected: Each term is either plain language or has a one-line explanation on first sight.
actual: "UP · 14", "DOWN · 10" and "Table UP" appear with no explanation (the landing page also says "up/down tables"). A blocked bid says "3 blocked (would make Σ=13)". The TRUMP column is a faint dot per player whose meaning ("Mark as trump winner") exists only as a hidden label; it is optional in a normal session and nothing says so. Advanced rules are described as "Highest bidder picks trump suit + hierarchy each round" and the options are "Standard (A high → 2 low)" and "Down-Up (A,2,3…K)" with no heading.
why_it_matters: I have played at a table and still had to guess at each of these. They are on the two screens used most.
suggested_fix: Write "Over (14)" / "Under (10)" or make the badge tappable for a one-line explanation; say "total can't be 13"; label the dot column "Who called trump? (optional)"; head the order buttons "Card order".

title: After claiming a player nothing confirms who I am now, and I cannot undo it, rename myself or leave
where: Join dialog "JOINING THURSDAY WHIST"; group home after joining; menu
steps: Signed in, open the invite link, tap Continue
Choose the existing player יוסי and tap Join Group
Look for confirmation of who I am in the group
Open the menu and the tabs to look for a way to change my name, undo the choice or leave the group
expected: A line such as "You are now יוסי — 71 rounds of history are yours", my row marked in the standings, and a note on how to fix a wrong pick.
actual: The question itself is clear: "Are you one of these players? Claiming keeps your game history." But after Join Group I am dropped on the Sessions tab with no message and no "you" mark on any row; I confirmed the claim only by opening Profile ("יוסי · 71 rounds played"). The button stays "Join Group" with no confirmation step. The menu offers only My Account, Ask About the Game, About & Privacy and Sign Out. As the group admin (second browser) I saw an "Unclaim" button, but the joiner is never told.
why_it_matters: Picking the wrong name hands me another person's history in one tap, and I see no way back.
evidence: Tool output as admin: יוסי ... Claimed / eli.barak.cards@example.com / [33] Make Admin | [34] Unclaim | [35] Remove
suggested_fix: Show each candidate's rounds played; rename the button "Join as יוסי"; after joining show "You joined as יוסי. Wrong player? Ask your group admin to undo it." and mark my row in standings.

title: With Advanced rules on, Lock Bids stays disabled with no reason given and sits below the fold
where: Bidding (step 1 of 2) in a session started with Advanced rules
steps: Start a session with Advanced rules switched on, start a round, enter four bids
Look for the next button
Scroll down, pick a suit, then pick a card order
expected: A line says what is still missing, as step 2 does ("Tricks must total exactly 13 (currently 12).").
actual: After the fourth bid the suit and order buttons appear and push Lock Bids under the bottom bar. It is disabled; no text says why. It stays disabled after choosing a suit and becomes active only after also choosing Standard or Down-Up. In a normal session the same push happens when a trump winner is marked.
why_it_matters: The only way forward is off-screen and greyed out, with no hint of what to do.
evidence: Tool output after choosing ♠: [33] button "Lock Bids" disabled ; after choosing Down-Up: ~ [33] button "Lock Bids"
suggested_fix: Under the disabled button write what is missing ("Choose the trump suit and card order"), and keep Lock Bids visible above the bottom bar.

title: Sign-up never asks my name; My Account shows "User" and offers nothing but Sign Out
steps: Create an account with e-mail and password
Open the menu -> My Account
expected: My name (or at least a way to set it), and the usual account actions: change password, delete account.
actual: My Account shows the avatar letter, the name "User", my e-mail and a Sign Out button. Nothing can be edited. The About page says to e-mail the developer to delete an account. On sign-up the 8-character password rule appears only after a failed attempt, and the form has no link to About & privacy.
why_it_matters: "User" looks unfinished, and a person who wants to change a password or leave has no place to do it.
evidence: Tool output on /account: # MY ACCOUNT / N | User / noa.levi.whist@example.com / [3] Sign Out
Tool output: http 400 POST /api/apps/sandbox/auth/register — {"message":"Password must be at least 8 characters"}
suggested_fix: Hide the name when there is none or let the user set it; add Change password and a Delete my account link (even one that opens the e-mail); state "at least 8 characters" under the password field; link About & privacy from sign-up.

title: Password reset works, but success is not confirmed and a used link is a dead end
steps: Login -> Forgot password? -> enter e-mail -> Send reset link
Open the link from the (simulated) e-mail, enter a new password twice, tap Reset password
Open the same link again and submit
expected: "Password changed — log in with your new password"; on a used link, a way to request a new one.
actual: After Reset password I was on the ordinary login screen ("Welcome back — Log in to your account") with no message; the listing and the screenshot taken right after show none. The new password worked and the old one was refused. Re-using the link shows "Invalid or expired reset link" above the same two password fields, with no link to request another or to go back to log in.
why_it_matters: I was not sure the change had happened until I tried to log in.
evidence: Tool output: OK tapped [3] button "Reset password" → now at /login ... # Welcome back / Log in to your account
suggested_fix: Show a confirmation on the login screen after a reset, and put "Request a new link" and "Back to log in" on the expired-link state.

title: Member words change from screen to screen: Unclaimed, "hasn't created an account", Ghost members, Soft-deletes
where: /admin: Members, Add Player dialog, Danger Zone
steps: Add three players without accounts
Read their rows
Tap Remove on one who has played, then Confirm
Read the Danger Zone
expected: One plain word for a player without an account, explained once; Remove not offered where it cannot work.
actual: The Add dialog says "a player who hasn't created an account yet. They can claim their profile later." The rows say "Unclaimed" / "Claimed" with no explanation. Remove asks Confirm / Cancel without saying what it does, then refuses: ""Dana" has game history and cannot be removed. Ghost members with history stay on the roster." The Danger Zone says "Soft-deletes the group".
why_it_matters: Three names for the same thing, one of them ("ghost") appearing only inside an error.
suggested_fix: Use one term (for example "No account yet"), hide or disable Remove for players with history and say why, and replace "Soft-deletes" with what the user experiences ("Hides the group; can be restored on request").

title: Back on a player page always goes to History, and phone screens stack two back arrows
steps: Open a session, tap a player in its standings
Tap "← Back"
On any round or session screen look at the two arrows at the top
expected: Back returns to the session I came from. One back control, or both labelled.
actual: Back went to /history, not the session. On phone the header has an unlabelled "←" (it leaves the group for the groups list) directly above a second "← Session" / "← Back". On desktop the header arrow is labelled "← Groups".
why_it_matters: During a night the scorekeeper jumps between the session and player pages; landing on History each time, or leaving the group by the wrong arrow, costs taps.
evidence: Tool output: OK tapped link "Back" → now at /history (came from /session/d3d91e22ce9fd1fc7138365b)
suggested_fix: Make Back return to the previous screen; label the header arrow "Groups" on phone too (or use a different icon).

title: The app and its things have several names: WHIST / WhistMate / Israeli Whist; session / game / night; note / scouting note / table talk
where: Header, share text, Admin, Profile, Activity
steps: Compare the header with the landing title
Tap Share Invite Link and read the text it shares
Read Admin's back link, the profile chart, the note dialog and the Activity empty state
expected: One name for the product and one for each thing.
actual: Phone header: "WHIST"; title: "WHISTMATE"; shared text: "Join our whist group "Friday Kitchen Whist" on Israeli Whist: …/join?code=77ITN5". Admin's back link is "Back to Games" and leads to SESSIONS; the profile says "Play at least 2 games to see your trend" and the chart axis "Games played" where it counts rounds; empty states say "whist night". The same feature is "Leave a Note", "SCOUTING NOTE", "TABLE TALK" and, in Activity, "scouting note".
why_it_matters: A friend receiving "…on Israeli Whist" will not connect it to an app called WhistMate, and "games" made me unsure whether it meant rounds or nights.
evidence: Captured share data: {"title":"Join my whist group","text":"Join our whist group \"Friday Kitchen Whist\" on Israeli Whist: http://localhost:4601/join?code=77ITN5"}
suggested_fix: Say "on WhistMate" in the share text; pick session or night, and round, and use them everywhere; pick one name for notes.

title: On a 320px phone the RESULTS heading is cut to "R…" and the number pad is below the fold
steps: Open a round in step 2 at 320x568
expected: The heading fits and the pad is reachable without scrolling past the player rows.
actual: The heading shows "R…" next to "Round 4 · step 2 of 2" and "0 / 13 tricks"; the fourth player row is half hidden and the pad and Save Round need a 242px scroll.
why_it_matters: Small phones are still common at a card table; the step name is the main orientation cue.
evidence: Tool output: VIEW small 320x568 · scrolled 0/242px (more below)
suggested_fix: Let the step text wrap under the heading on narrow screens and tighten the row height.

title: 0-BID SUCCESS shows 0% when no zero bid was ever made
steps: Play one round without a zero bid
Open the player page
expected: A dash or "no zero bids yet".
actual: "0-BID SUCCESS 0% · 0/0 zero-bids".
why_it_matters: 0% reads as failure; it made me check whether I had done something wrong.
suggested_fix: Show "—" when the denominator is 0.

title: Claim dialog layout: Join Group and Back touch, and the name rows are narrower than "I'm a new player"
steps: Open the invite link signed in, tap Continue
Look at the buttons
expected: Even spacing and equal widths.
actual: The yellow Join Group button sits directly on top of the Back button with no gap; the two player rows end a few pixels short of the "I'm a new player" row.
why_it_matters: Polish on the one screen every invited person sees.
suggested_fix: Add the standard gap between the two buttons and give all three option rows the same width.

title: Every new session is named "Whist Night", and the session card shows "Advanced" but not the scoring method
steps: Start two sessions on the same day without changing the name, the second with Progressive and Advanced rules
expected: Sessions I can tell apart, and the scoring method visible on the card.
actual: Both are "Whist Night · Nov 19, 2026". The open one shows "Advanced" on its card; "Progressive" appears only inside the session ("Open · Advanced · Progressive").
why_it_matters: History fills with identical names; the scoring method changes every number in the session.
evidence: Tool output: [4] Whist Night | OPEN / Nov 19, 2026 | 1 round | Advanced ... [16] Whist Night | CLOSED / Nov 19, 2026 | 1 round
suggested_fix: Default the name to the weekday and date ("Thursday, Nov 19") or number it, and show Classic / Progressive on the card.

title: Closing a night ends quietly: a browser confirm, no summary, no way back that I could see
steps: Tap Close Session and accept the confirm
expected: A small end-of-night moment: who won, final table.
actual: A native browser dialog ("Close this session? No more rounds can be added."), then the same page with "Closed" in the subtitle and the Start Round button gone. I saw no reopen control on the session or in Admin.
why_it_matters: The landing page promises "bragging rights"; the end of the night is where that should show.
evidence: Tool output: ! dialog confirm "Close this session? No more rounds can be added." → accepted (OK)
suggested_fix: Use the app's own dialog, and after closing show a short result card (winner, final standings, share button).

title: A started round cannot be dropped or re-seated, and it blocks closing the session
where: Bidding and results screens /round/<id>; session screen /session/<id>
steps: Open session, tap START ROUND 6
Tap four players (the wrong ones), tap Start Round (4/4)
On the bidding screen look for a way to change players or discard the round
Go back to the session and look at the round's card and for Close Session
expected: A 'Change players' or 'Discard round' control on a round that has no scores yet; Close Session still available or an explanation why not.
actual: No such control on the bidding step, the results step, the menu or the session card ('Open round →' only). Close Session disappears while the round exists, with no explanation. Delete Round exists only on scored rounds, so I had to invent 4 bids, lock, invent 4 tricks, save, open the round, Delete Round and confirm: 13 taps, with two non-players appearing in the standings meanwhile.
why_it_matters: Picking the wrong table is the most ordinary mistake of the night and the recovery is longer than a real round; a night that ends mid-round cannot be closed without fake data.
evidence: Text search on the bidding screen for delete|discard|cancel|remove|players|change printed: OK eval → null
Scored round page listed: [4] button "Edit Round" [5] button "Delete Round"; bidding page listed neither
suggested_fix: Add 'Discard round' (and ideally 'Change players') to rounds in bidding/playing state, and allow closing a session by discarding its unfinished round.

title: Bidding and results do not fit shorter phones; Lock Bids goes off-screen once trump is marked
steps: Start a round at 375x667: look at the bidding screen without scrolling
At 390x844 enter four bids and tap a trump dot, pick a suit
expected: Player rows, the full number pad and the Lock Bids / Save Round button visible together, on every common phone height.
actual: 375x667: only the first pad row is visible, 7-13 are behind the bottom tab bar and Lock Bids is 129 px below the fold. 320x568: the four player rows fill the screen and the whole pad is below the fold (343 px of scrolling to Lock Bids with the suit picker open). 390x844: marking a trump winner opens a suit picker that stays open and pushes Lock Bids 71 px below the fold (115 px in Advanced sessions, every round).
why_it_matters: The one button that moves the round forward is not on screen at the moment it is needed; one-handed scrolling between every bid on a small phone defeats the tap-tap rhythm.
suggested_fix: During a round hide the bottom tab bar and shrink the header/'← Session' rows, pin Lock Bids / Save Round to the bottom, and collapse the suit picker after a suit is chosen.

title: 'Edit bids' wipes tricks already typed although the screen says they are untouched
steps: Lock bids
Enter tricks for the first two players (counter shows 9 / 13)
Tap Edit bids
Tap Cancel (or Save Bids)
expected: The two trick entries still there, as the notice promises: 'tricks already typed in are untouched.'
actual: Both entries back to '—', counter '0 / 13 tricks', and the cursor still on the third player ('Tricks for Dan'). Same after Save Bids.
why_it_matters: The scorekeeper continues from player 3, ends with two blanks and a disabled Save Round, and has to ask for tricks again; the app's own sentence says this will not happen.
evidence: After Edit bids → Save Bids: '# RESULTS | Round 5 · step 2 of 2 | 0 / 13 tricks' ... 'Tricks for Dan'
suggested_fix: Keep the typed tricks (and renege marks) across Edit bids; if they must be cleared, say so and put the cursor back on the first player.

title: Bidding assumes player 1 bids first; the cursor jumps to the first empty row and 'Same players' repeats last round's order
where: Pick the table /session/<id>/round/new and bidding screen /round/<id>
steps: Start a round with 'Same players as last round'
Tap row 3 and enter her bid
Watch which player the pad moves to
expected: After player 3, the pad moves to player 4, then 1, then 2 (clockwise from whoever bid first); the shortcut offers the next starting player.
actual: After player 3 the pad moved to player 1, then 2, then 4, and the total-13 block landed on player 4. 'Same players as last round' numbered the players exactly as in the previous round, while the seeded rounds 1-4 of the same session each start with a different player.
why_it_matters: At a real table the first bidder changes every round, so either every bid needs an extra tap on a row or bids get typed onto the wrong player, and the 13 block falls on the wrong person.
evidence: After entering Rachel (row 3): '~ Bid for Maya' ... then '~ Bid for Omer' ... then '~ Bid for Dan · 3 blocked (would make Σ=13)'
Seeded rounds: R1 Maya, Dan, נועה, יוסי · R2 Dan, נועה, יוסי, Maya · R3 נועה, יוסי, Maya, Dan · R4 יוסי, Maya, Dan, נועה; 'Same players' for R5 gave 1 יוסי, 2 Maya, 3 Dan, 4 נועה
suggested_fix: Advance clockwise from the row the scorekeeper started on, wrapping around; let 'Same players' keep the seats and pick or rotate the first bidder.

title: Unlocked bids and unsaved tricks vanish without warning when the round screen is left or reloaded
steps: Enter four bids, do not lock, tap the header arrow or the Sessions tab, come back via RESUME ROUND
Or: lock bids, enter two tricks, press browser Back / reload / open History, come back
expected: The entries still there, or a warning before leaving.
actual: All rows back to '—' ('Bid for נועה', Lock Bids disabled; '0 / 13 tricks'). No warning on leaving, nothing on return about what was kept. Locked bids are kept.
why_it_matters: Bids are said aloud once; losing them means asking four impatient players again. Not knowing what survives makes every stray tap a worry.
evidence: After leaving with four unlocked bids and resuming: '[4] 1. נועה | — ... [26] button "Lock Bids" disabled'
After Back with two tricks typed and resuming: '# RESULTS | Round 5 · step 2 of 2 | 0 / 13 tricks'
After reload with two tricks typed: same '0 / 13 tricks'
suggested_fix: Keep a draft of the round's entries on the device (per round) and restore it on return; at minimum warn before leaving a round with unsaved entries.

title: An open, unfinished session already counts as a win for whoever is leading
steps: Open the group home while a session is open and note each player's 'wins'
Play rounds until the lead changes, look again
Close the session, look again
expected: Wins change only when a session is closed.
actual: נועה 4 wins while leading the open session; Maya 10 / נועה 3 after Maya took the lead; Maya 9 / נועה 4 after the close. With the next session open, Dan shows 3 wins (was 2). In the open session the leader's row reads '1 win'.
why_it_matters: The all-time table shows wins that have not happened and they flip during the night; a session left open keeps its win forever. People argue about exactly these numbers.
evidence: Mid-session: '#1 M Maya 135 rounds · 10 wins' / '#2 נ נועה 108 rounds · 3 wins'; after close: 'Maya 140 rounds · 9 wins' / 'נועה 113 rounds · 4 wins'
suggested_fix: Count wins from closed sessions only; in an open session show 'leading' instead of '1 win'.

title: No preview of what a round will score; RENEGE is a small unconfirmed pill worth -100
steps: Lock bids
Tap RENEGE on a player
Enter tricks, tap Save Round
Separately: enter tricks so nobody makes their bid and save
expected: Before saving, see each player's points (or at least made/missed), what a renege costs, and a notice when the round will be cancelled because everyone fell.
actual: RENEGE only turns a 57x19 px pill red; the saved card then shows -120. The everyone-fell round saved as four zeros tagged EVERYONE FELL with nothing beforehand. The pill sits inside the tappable player row.
why_it_matters: The scorekeeper announces results to the table; surprises after Save cause arguments and re-edits, and a stray tap can cost someone 100 points unnoticed.
suggested_fix: Show points per player as tricks are entered, label a renege with its cost, show an 'Everyone fell — round scores 0' banner before Save, and move RENEGE away from the row's main tap area.

title: The header arrow on a phone leaves the group; two stacked back arrows
where: Any round or session screen, top-left
steps: On a round screen tap the arrow in the top bar
expected: Go back one step, or a labelled control that says where it goes.
actual: Lands on 'Your Groups' (/home). The arrow is a bare 16x16 icon with no label, directly above a second '← Session' arrow. Returning takes three taps and unlocked entries are gone. On desktop the same control is labelled '← Groups'.
why_it_matters: Two arrows that look alike and do different things; the wrong one throws the scorekeeper out of the night.
evidence: OK tapped [1] button (no label; icon=arrow-left) → now at /home
suggested_fix: Label it 'Groups' on phones too, or hide it inside a session/round; give it a 44 px target and an accessible name.

title: Advanced session: Lock Bids stays disabled with no reason; card order is unheaded and not shown during play
where: Bidding screen /round/<id> in a session with Advanced rules
steps: Enter four bids (highest bidder is pre-marked '?')
Pick a suit
Look at Lock Bids
expected: A line saying what is still missing, a heading on the card-order choice, and the chosen order visible on the results screen.
actual: Lock Bids stays disabled after the suit is chosen, no message. It enables only after tapping one of two unheaded pills, 'Standard (A high → 2 low)' / 'Down-Up (A,2,3…K)', required even for NT. The results header shows suit and winner but not the card order.
why_it_matters: A greyed main button with no reason stalls the table; the card order is what players ask about mid-hand.
evidence: Results header: 'Table UP · trump ♥ Hearts · won by Maya' (no card order); round page: 'Trump ♥ Hearts · won by Maya · Down-Up (A,2,3…K)'
suggested_fix: Say 'Pick a suit and a card order to lock' under the button, add a 'Card order' heading, and show the order in the results header.

title: Trump control is a faint dot; a winner marked without a suit is dropped silently
steps: Enter four bids
Tap a player's trump dot (shows '?'), do not pick a suit
Tap Lock Bids
Tap Edit bids
expected: A control that reads as 'who won trump' at a glance; a prompt to pick the suit or the winner kept without one.
actual: The control is a dim dot under a small 'TRUMP' label. After locking, the results header read 'Table DOWN' with no trump, and Edit bids showed all four dots empty.
why_it_matters: Recording trump is optional and easy to miss; when half-entered it disappears without telling anyone.
evidence: After lock: 'Table DOWN | [4] Edit bids'; in Edit bids: '[10] 4. Dan | 4 | [11] ·'
suggested_fix: Give the control an icon or the word 'Trump', and either keep the winner without a suit or ask for the suit before locking.

title: Tap targets are small for one thumb in a noisy room
steps: Measure the controls on the bidding and results screens
expected: Primary targets of 44 px or more, the main button the largest.
actual: Number keys 42x42 with 6 px gaps; Lock Bids and Save Round 358x36; trump dot 36x36; RENEGE 57x19; Edit bids 65x16; '← Session' 70x20; header arrow 16x16.
why_it_matters: Mis-taps on a 14-key pad put a wrong number on a player; the main buttons are shorter than the keys above them.
suggested_fix: Enlarge the pad keys (the screen has spare height at 844) and make Lock Bids / Save Round at least 48 px tall; pad the small text links.

title: Fixing a saved round is a detour: two 'Edit round' taps, a different keyboard form, and no return
steps: On the session tap 'Edit round' on a round card
Tap 'Edit Round' on the page that opens
Change two trick fields with the keyboard
Scroll, tap Save Changes
expected: One tap from the card into the same tap-pad used during play, and back to the session after saving.
actual: The card link opens a read-only page with a second 'Edit Round' button; the form uses eight keyboard number fields; Save Changes is below the fold; after saving I stayed on the round page and needed '← Session'.
why_it_matters: Corrections happen with players waiting; a second style of entry and extra hops slow the one moment that is already awkward.
suggested_fix: Open the editor directly from the card (admin), reuse the tap pad, pin Save Changes, and return to the session after saving.

title: Closing the session: far away, no confirmation on screen, no final result, no reopen
steps: After 10 rounds scroll to the bottom of the session
Tap Close Session, accept the confirm
expected: A clear 'Session closed' state with the final standings/winner, and a way to reopen a session closed by mistake.
actual: The button is 2147 px down. After the confirm it simply disappears; the only change is 'Closed' in the small subtitle at the top of the page. No winner or summary. No reopen on the session page or in Admin.
why_it_matters: The end of the night is the moment everyone looks at the phone; it also cannot be undone if tapped early.
evidence: dialog confirm "Close this session? No more rounds can be added." → accepted (OK)
suggested_fix: After closing, scroll to the top and show a final-result banner; offer 'Reopen' to the admin.

title: No game-limit option found when starting a session
steps: Tap START NEW SESSION and read the form
Open Admin and read Group Settings
expected: A field to set a game limit for the session, as the review brief asked me to use.
actual: New Session has name, date, location, scoring method and Advanced rules only; Admin has default scoring and default Advanced rules. A text search of both pages for limit|target|max|cap returned an empty string.
why_it_matters: If the option exists it cannot be found where a session is set up; if it does not, the session cannot be given an end.
suggested_fix: If a game limit is meant to be a session option, put it on the New Session form; otherwise drop it from what users are told to expect.

title: 'Progressive' is described as escalating but is half of Classic for normal misses
steps: Start a Progressive session
Play rounds with misses of 1, 2, 3 and 4 tricks
expected: A description that tells the scorekeeper what the table will actually get.
actual: Form text: 'Classic = −10 per missed trick. Progressive = escalating penalty by miss size.' Observed: -5, -10, -15, -20 for misses of 1-4. The rules assistant gives the real rule (−5/trick for 1–4, −10/trick at 5, …).
why_it_matters: The rules are frozen for the whole session, so the choice has to be understood before the first round.
evidence: 'Maya♥ Hearts | bid 6 · won 3 | -15', 'Omer | bid 3 · won 5 | -10', 'Maya♠ Spades | bid 5 · won 4 | -5', 'Omer | bid 2 · won 6 | -20'
suggested_fix: Use the rules assistant's sentence in short form: 'Progressive: −5 per missed trick up to 4, steeper from 5.'

title: Developer wording in scorekeeper screens
where: Edit bids notice, bidding hint, save error, group standings header
steps: Tap Edit bids
Make the last bid total 13
Save with no connection
Look at the group standings after closing the session
expected: Plain words.
actual: 'Saving re-derives up/down and the trump record', '4 blocked (would make Σ=13)', 'Network Error'. The standings note '▲ this session' still shows the closed session's numbers when no session is open.
why_it_matters: Small, but these are read mid-game at a glance.
evidence: '## Standings | overall score · ▲ this session' with no open session
suggested_fix: 'Up/down and trump are updated when you save', '4 not allowed — bids can't add up to 13', 'Couldn't save — check the connection and tap Save again', '▲ last session'.

title: Fill in the fourth player's tricks automatically
steps: Enter tricks for three players
expected: The fourth is filled with 13 minus the others (still editable), and impossible numbers are dimmed.
actual: The fourth stays '—' and the pad accepts a number that makes '14 / 13 tricks'.
why_it_matters: One tap and one possible error saved every round.
suggested_fix: Pre-fill the last empty player and dim values that would exceed 13.

title: Show what the last round did to each player
steps: Save a round in a session with five or more players in the standings
expected: The points of the round just played visible without scrolling, for reading out to the table.
actual: Standings show totals only; with five players the new round card starts at the bottom edge and its rows are below the fold.
why_it_matters: 'What did I get?' is the first question after every hand.
suggested_fix: Show the last round's change next to each total, or put the newest round card above the standings.

title: One tap to start a round with an unchanged table
steps: Tap START ROUND n
Tap 'Same players as last round'
Tap 'Start Round (4/4)'
expected: One tap when the table has not changed; a shortcut for the first round of a new session.
actual: Three taps across two screens every round; the first round of a new session has no shortcut and needs five.
why_it_matters: It is the most repeated sequence of the night.
suggested_fix: Offer 'Same table' directly on the session screen next to START ROUND, and offer the last session's table in a new session.

title: A session from one group is shown under another group's name after the browser Back button
where: Session page, /session/05105854530bfdef2c63c6fb (Old Crew's "One last time") while Thursday Whist is the open group
steps: Sign in as Dan. On Your Groups tap Old Crew, tap the session "One last time".
Tap the arrow at the top left (goes to Your Groups).
Tap Thursday Whist.
Press the browser Back button twice.
expected: Either the Old Crew session under an "OLD CREW · ARCHIVED" header, or no session at all. The header should always name the group the page belongs to.
actual: The Old Crew session "One last time" (Gidi, Dan, Rachel, Omer) is shown under the header "THURSDAY WHIST", with no archived badge. One more Back lands on "/", which was Old Crew's home in the history but now shows Thursday Whist's home. Opening the same address directly while inside Thursday Whist does the same.
why_it_matters: The header is the only sign of which group you are in. Here it names the wrong group, so a player reads a night as belonging to a table it was never played at. Gidi is not even a member of Thursday Whist.
evidence: eval → "/session/05105854530bfdef2c63c6fb | h1=One last time | header=THURSDAY WHIST"
eval → "/ | h1=Sessions | header=THURSDAY WHIST" (third Back; this history entry was Old Crew's home)
suggested_fix: Take the group shown in the header from the page's own data (the session's, round's or player's group), not from the last-opened group. Better: put the group in the address (/g/<group>/session/<id>) so Back, reload and shared links always carry it.

title: After leaving a group, the browser Back button does nothing (four presses stuck on Your Groups)
where: Your Groups, /home, after tapping the top-left arrow inside a group
steps: Open Old Crew, tap History, open the session "One last time".
Tap the arrow at the top left. You land on Your Groups.
Press the browser Back button (on Android: the phone's Back button).
expected: Back returns to the session I was just reading.
actual: The screen stays on Your Groups. I pressed Back four times and saw Your Groups each time (once for each group page I had visited: session, History, Admin, a player page); only the fifth press moved, to the Activity page I had been on before entering the group. The same happened the first time I tried it, from a Thursday Whist session (two presses, both stuck).
why_it_matters: This was my first wrong turn (see returning-player-5: the arrow looks like 'back one step'), and Back could not undo it. On a phone the Back button is the reflex for 'oops'; here it looks broken.
evidence: OK tapped [1] button (no label; icon=arrow-left) → now at /home
OK went back / eval → "/home | Your Groups" (printed for presses 1, 2, 3 and 4)
OK went back → now at /activity (fifth press)
storage after leaving the group: the key eos_activeGroupId is gone; inside the group it was eos_activeGroupId = 0932e6ffba71ba139a4f222d
suggested_fix: Same cause as returning-player-1: group pages depend on a remembered 'open group' that the arrow clears, so every earlier page bounces to Your Groups. Keep the group in the address, or do not clear the open group when going to Your Groups.

title: Wins, win rate and podiums count the session that is still being played
where: Group home standings (/), session standings (/session/001ca3e176b3422b4928e3db), player pages (/player/<id>, /profile)
steps: Open Thursday Whist. Note the open session "Midweek special" (round 4 in play).
Read the standings: Maya 9 wins, נועה 4 wins, Dan 2 wins.
Open every closed session in History and note who is #1.
expected: A win is a finished session won. The app's own tooltip says so: "Share of sessions finished in 1st place." נועה won 3 of the 14 closed sessions (Rematch, ערב מתקדמים, Season opener).
actual: נועה is credited with 4 wins and a 36% win rate (4 of 11 sessions). The fourth is the open session, which she currently leads after 3 rounds; its own standings already say "נועה · 3 rounds · 1 win". The 15 wins on the table (9 + 4 + 2) equal 15 sessions, one of them unfinished. Podiums do the same: Dan shows 7 podiums in 12 sessions; he finished top-3 in 6 closed sessions and is third in the open one.
why_it_matters: These are headline numbers and they are wrong by the app's own definition while a night is in progress. A player who checks the table mid-evening sees a win handed out for a night nobody has won, and it can move to someone else an hour later. If you apply the 'wrong data' rule strictly this is a blocker; I rate it major because it corrects itself when the session is closed.
evidence: [6] link "#2 נ נועה 106 rounds · 4 wins · +11.13 avg +1180 +90" (group home)
[6] link "#1 נ נועה 3 rounds · 1 win · +30 avg +90" (open session Midweek special)
Tooltip text: "Share of sessions finished in 1st place." and "Sessions finished in the top 3."
#1 in the 14 closed sessions, as printed: Maya ×9, נועה ×3 (Rematch, ערב מתקדמים, Season opener), Dan ×2 (Whist & pizza, Marathon)
suggested_fix: Count wins, win rate, podiums and 'sessions' from closed sessions only. In a session's own standings drop the 'N wins' text (it is always 0 or 1) and mark the winner of a closed session with a small trophy instead; show 'leading' for an open one.

title: Group tabs: the label and icon do not match what is inside ("Sessions" holds the standings and awards, the trophy holds the list of sessions)
where: Bottom bar inside a group: Sessions (/), History (/history), Profile (/profile)
steps: Open Thursday Whist and read the bottom bar: Sessions (spade), History (trophy), Profile (person).
Look at what each one contains.
expected: From label and icon alone I can guess the content: the trophy leads to standings and awards; 'Sessions' leads to the list of sessions.
actual: "Sessions" (spade icon, page title SESSIONS) is the group's home: one active-session card, then the overall Standings, then the Awards, then three recent sessions. "History" (trophy icon) is the plain list of all 15 sessions, with no standings, winners or awards. Standings and Awards, the two things I came for, have no tab, label or icon of their own. In the archived Old Crew the page titled SESSIONS shows no session at all on the first screen.
why_it_matters: The bar is the app's map. A returning player who wants 'the table' has no tab that says so, and the one icon that means 'winners' opens a list of dates. It works only because the standings happen to be on the first screen you land on.
evidence: Listing of /: "# SESSIONS", "## Standings", "## Awards", "## Recent | All history"; listing of /history: "# HISTORY" followed only by session cards
suggested_fix: Rename the first tab to "Standings" (or "Table") with the trophy icon and title the page the same; rename "History" to "Sessions" with a calendar icon. See returning-player-24 for the whole proposal.

title: On a phone the arrow that leaves the group has no label, and sits right above a second back arrow that goes somewhere else
where: Header of every page inside a group; session, round and player pages (phone 390 and 320 wide)
steps: Open Thursday Whist, open the session "Midweek special".
Two left arrows are on screen: a bare one in the header, and "← Sessions" below it.
Tap the bare arrow in the header.
expected: The top-left arrow goes back one step (to the group's home), as it does in most phone apps; or it says where it goes.
actual: It leaves the group and lands on Your Groups, from any depth. On desktop the same control reads "← Groups"; on the phone the word is dropped and the control has no accessible name. The menu has no 'Switch group' or 'All groups' entry, so this bare arrow is the only way between the two levels.
why_it_matters: It was my first wrong turn: I meant 'back to the group' and was thrown out of it, and Back then did not bring me back (returning-player-2). The only door between 'all groups' and 'one group' is an unlabelled icon that looks like something else.
evidence: [1] button (no label) icon=arrow-left   /   [3] button "Sessions"   (session page listing)
OK tapped [1] button (no label; icon=arrow-left) → now at /home
suggested_fix: On phones show "‹ Groups" (or a group-switcher: the group name with a small chevron that opens the list of groups), and give it an accessible name. Keep one back control per page: inside a session the header control could become "‹ Thursday Whist".

title: "← Back" on a player's page always goes to History, wherever you came from
steps: Open Thursday Whist, tap Profile, choose Maya under "View another player".
Tap "← Back" at the top of Maya's page.
expected: Back to my profile, where I came from.
actual: It opens the History tab (the list of sessions). The link points to /history on every player page: also when I came from the standings on the group home, and when I came from the Activity feed.
why_it_matters: Comparing myself with another player means going to and fro between two pages. Each 'Back' dropped me on an unrelated list, and I had to find my way again.
evidence: OK tapped [2] option "Maya" → now at /player/736e73dde5d53eaa9642e556   …   [3] link "Back" → /history
OK tapped [3] link "Back" → now at /history   /   eval → "/history | History"
From the group home: OK tapped link "#3 D Dan …" → now at /player/54a11a2ef4c8c7ec847c5fb4 … [3] link "Back" → /history
suggested_fix: Make it a real 'back' (previous page), falling back to the group's standings when there is no previous page. The rules page already does this correctly.

title: "My best night" and "the round that hurt me most" cannot be found without opening every session and scanning every round
steps: Open Profile and look for my best night: not there.
Open History: each card shows name, date, place and number of rounds, no winner and no score.
Open each of my sessions to read my total.
In "Last Thursday" look for my worst round: scan all 10 round cards for the row "Dan".
expected: My profile names my best and worst night; the History list shows who won each session and my result; inside a session my own rows stand out.
actual: I opened every session in History (15; I played in 12) to learn that my best night was "Whist & pizza" (Oct 8, +249) and my worst "Whist Night" (Jul 16, −114). In a session my row is not highlighted and its position changes from round to round (rows follow the seating order), newest round first. Last Thursday had no single worst round: six rounds at −5 (1, 2, 5, 6, 7, 8). The 'Score over time' chart names a point only as "Game 74", with no session or date.
why_it_matters: These are the questions a player asks a week later. The data is all there, but the app makes me do the search and the sums.
evidence: [5] link "#1 D Dan 10 rounds · 1 win · +24.9 avg +249" (Whist & pizza)  /  [9] link "#5 D Dan 8 rounds · 0 wins · -14.25 avg -114" (Whist Night, Jul 16)
suggested_fix: On each History card show the winner and, for sessions I played, my place and score ("You: 4th, +64"). On the profile add Best night / Worst night / Best round, each a link. In session round cards highlight the signed-in player's row, and mark the biggest gain and loss.

title: My round history is not on my Profile tab; it exists only on a second 'me' page, stops at 50 rows without saying so, and names no session
where: /profile (Profile tab) versus /player/54a11a2ef4c8c7ec847c5fb4 (my name tapped in the standings); round page /round/<id>
steps: Tap the Profile tab: stats, awards, chart, "View another player", Table Talk. No round history.
Go to the group home and tap my own name in the standings: a different page about me, with ROUND HISTORY and a Leave a Note button, and without "View another player".
Scroll the round history to its end.
expected: One page about me, with the same content however I reach it. A list that is cut says so ("showing 50 of 113") and offers the rest. Each row says which session it belongs to.
actual: Two different pages about me. The round history shows exactly 50 rows (the header says "113 rounds played") and then simply ends at "Round 4 · Sep 24, 2026" with no 'more' control and no count. Rows read "Round 3 · Nov 18, 2026 · bid 3 · won 3": no session name, so two sessions on the same date could not be told apart. The round page they open shows no session name and no date either, and it cannot be reached from the session's own list of rounds (those cards are not links).
why_it_matters: The round history is the most useful list for a returning player and it is hidden behind an unlikely tap (my own row in the standings). Where it does appear it looks complete but is not.
evidence: Listing of /profile: "## PERFORMANCE … ## STRATEGY … ## AWARDS … ## SCORE OVER TIME … VIEW ANOTHER PLAYER … ## TABLE TALK" (no ROUND HISTORY)
Listing of /player/54a11a2ef4c8c7ec847c5fb4: "## ROUND HISTORY", rows [18] to [67] (50 rows), then "[68] Leave a Note"
suggested_fix: Make the Profile tab and /player/<me> the same page. Group the round history by session (session name and date as a header, tappable) and add 'Show more' with a count. Put the session name and date on the round page, and let the session's round cards open it.

title: Notes are buried: tapping a note in Activity lands on the top of a long player page, with the note and "Leave a Note" five screens further down
steps: On Your Groups tap Activity, tap the note "Anonymous left a note about Rachel".
You land on Rachel's page, at the top (stats).
Scroll past the stats, the awards, the chart and 50 round rows to reach "Leave a Note" and Table Talk.
expected: The tapped note is on screen when the page opens; writing a note is one tap from the feed or from the top of a player's page.
actual: The page opens at scroll position 0 of 4262 px; the note is at about 4262. There is no 'write a note' control in Activity or near the top of a player page. On my own Profile tab there is no Leave a Note at all, while on the other 'me' page I am offered "Leave a public note about Dan" (about myself).
why_it_matters: I tapped a note and saw a stats page with no note in sight; I had to guess it was at the bottom. Leaving a note, the only social thing a non-scorekeeper can do, takes a long scroll every time.
evidence: OK tapped [4] button "A Anonymous left a note about Rachel …" → now at /player/9ebb704c792d1c8842158178   /   VIEW phone 390x844 · scrolled 0/4262px (more below)
After posting: VIEW phone 390x844 · scrolled 4262/4405px … "[20] Leave a Note / ## TABLE TALK / D | Dan / Last Thursday · Nov 12, 2026"
Dialog on my own page: "## SCOUTING NOTE / Leave a public note about Dan."
suggested_fix: Move Table Talk and Leave a Note above the round history (or make the round history a collapsed section). When a player page is opened from a note, scroll to that note and highlight it. Add a 'Write a note' button to Activity that asks which player.

title: The same note carries two different dates, and round rows carry a different date from their session
where: Activity (/activity) versus Table Talk on a player page; Round history on a player page
steps: Leave a note about Rachel and link it to the session "Last Thursday · Nov 12, 2026".
Read it on Rachel's page, then in Activity.
Compare the round-history dates of the open session with the session's date.
expected: A session name is always shown with that session's date. If the day the note was written matters, it is labelled as such ("written Nov 19").
actual: On Rachel's page: "Last Thursday · Nov 12, 2026". In Activity the same note: "Thursday Whist · Last Thursday · Nov 19, 2026". The seeded notes show the same pattern (profile "Whist Night · Jul 16, 2026", Activity "Whist Night · Jul 17, 2026"). Separately, the three scored rounds of "Midweek special · Nov 19, 2026" are listed in the round history as "Nov 18, 2026" (the browser's clock read Thu Nov 19 2026 00:44 GMT+0200; this may be how the demo data was stamped, or a UTC date being shown — worth a look, since real whist nights cross midnight).
why_it_matters: "Last Thursday · Nov 19" reads as if that session was played on Nov 19. A player trying to place a note or a round in time gets two answers.
evidence: Rachel's page: "D | Dan / Last Thursday · Nov 12, 2026 / Rachel bids 5 like it is nothing. Last Thursday proved it."
Activity: "[3] D | Dan left a note about Rachel / Thursday Whist · Last Thursday · Nov 19, 2026"
Dan's page: "A | Anonymous / Whist Night · Jul 16, 2026"; Activity: "Anonymous left a note about you / Thursday Whist · Whist Night · Jul 17, 2026"
Round history: "[18] Round 3 / Nov 18, 2026 · bid 3 · won 3"; session header: "# Midweek special / Nov 19, 2026 · אצל מאיה · Open · Classic"
suggested_fix: In Activity show when the note was written as relative time ("today", "3 days ago") and keep the session's own date next to the session name. In the round history show the session's name and date, not the round's timestamp.

title: My own note raises the 'new' badge on Activity; Activity exists only outside the group and holds notes only
where: Bottom bar on Your Groups (/home), Activity (/activity)
steps: Open Activity once (the 9+ badge clears).
Go into Thursday Whist and leave a note about Rachel.
Go back to the all-groups level.
expected: Nothing new for me: I wrote it. And while I am inside a group I can see that something new happened there.
actual: The Activity tab shows a badge "1"; the new item is my own note, worded "Dan left a note about Rachel". On my first visit the badge read "9+" for a feed of ten notes, one of them my own from July. Inside a group there is no Activity tab and no badge, so 'is there anything new?' means leaving the group first. The feed lists notes only: a closed session, a new winner or a new member never appears, although the label 'Activity' and the pulse icon promise more.
why_it_matters: A badge that fires for my own action teaches me to ignore it. And the place I look for news (inside my group) has none.
evidence: [6] link "1 Activity" → /activity (printed right after I posted the note)
"[3] D | Dan left a note about Rachel / Thursday Whist · Last Thursday · Nov 19, 2026"
In-group bottom bar: "[12] Sessions | [13] History | [14] Profile"
suggested_fix: Do not count the viewer's own notes as unread, and word them "You left a note about Rachel". Show the unread dot on the group card in Your Groups and inside the group. Either rename the tab "Notes" (speech-bubble icon) or add session results to the feed.

title: "Profile" means two different pages, and "My Account" is a third, nearly empty one
where: Bottom bar at both levels; menu → My Account (/account); /profile/global; /profile
steps: On Your Groups tap Profile (globe-and-person icon).
Inside a group tap Profile (person icon).
Open the menu and tap My Account (person icon).
expected: One word, one meaning. A label that says what is inside.
actual: Top-level "Profile" opens a page titled GLOBAL STATS (stats across groups, plus a "Back to Groups" link that repeats the Groups tab). In-group "Profile" opens a page titled DAN (stats in this group). "My Account" shows my name, my e-mail and a Sign Out button, all of which the menu itself already shows (it adds only the surname). None of the three lets me change anything about myself.
why_it_matters: I would not have guessed that 'Profile' is a statistics page, nor that it changes meaning when I enter a group. 'Find your account' took me to a page with nothing to do on it.
evidence: Listing of /account: "# MY ACCOUNT / D | Dan Levi / dan@example.com / [3] Sign Out"
suggested_fix: Top level: call the tab "My stats" (or "Me") and put the account card (name, e-mail, sign out) at its foot; drop the separate My Account page. In a group: call the tab "Players" or "Me" and keep the player switcher at the top.

title: "My Account" and "About & Privacy" take you out of the group without saying so; About's Back goes to Your Groups
where: Menu inside a group → My Account (/account), About & Privacy (/about)
steps: Inside Old Crew open the menu and tap About & Privacy.
Look at the header and bottom bar; tap "← Back".
expected: A side page opened from inside a group returns me to where I was, as the rules page does.
actual: Both pages switch to the all-groups frame (WHIST logo, Groups / Activity / Profile). About's "← Back" is a fixed link to Your Groups, so I ended outside the group I was in. My Account has no back control at all and no tab is highlighted. (The browser Back button does return to the group from both.) "Ask About the Game" behaves differently again: a full-screen page with no bars and a Back that returns correctly.
why_it_matters: Three menu items, three different behaviours, and two of them move me between the app's two levels as a side effect.
evidence: OK tapped menuitem "About & Privacy" → now at /about … [3] link "Back" → /home … "[5] Groups | [6] 1 Activity | [7] Profile"

Use one name everywhere: "WhistMate" in the store listing and in the header at every width (the phone header has room: the wordmark is 18 px in a 390 px bar).
