suggested_fix: Phone: make it a bottom sheet — width 100%, anchored to the bottom, border-radius 20px 20px 0 0, background #182749 (the card colour), padding 24px 16px calc(24px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), a 36x4 px grab handle; or keep it centred with margin 16 px and radius 14 px. Buttons: 48 px high, gap 12 px, primary first. Close X: 44x44 hit area. Placeholder: text-transform none on ::placeholder ("e.g. ABC123"). Pick one name for notes ("Table talk": button "Add table talk", dialog "New table-talk note").

title: The "page not found" screen is a white, generic template with no WhistMate identity
steps: Open http://localhost:4604/this-page-does-not-exist
expected: A navy WhistMate screen with the spade mark, the same empty-state layout as the rest of the app and a way home.
actual: A light-grey/white page with a pale "404", "Page Not Found", the sentence "The page \"this-page-does-not-exist\" could not be found in this application." and a white "Go Home" button. No header, no logo, no navy, no gold. It is the only light screen in the product.
why_it_matters: A mistyped or stale link drops the user onto something that looks like a different website — the one moment they most need reassurance that they are still in the app.
evidence: look output: "# 404 / ## Page Not Found / The page \"this-page-does-not-exist\" could not be found in this application. / [1] button \"Go Home\""
suggested_fix: Restyle with the app's tokens: background #0E1D3E, the standard header, the empty-state component (64 px circle icon, 18 px title "Page not found", 14 px muted line "That link doesn't lead anywhere."), primary gold button "Back to groups" 48 px high.

title: Hebrew notes and names are laid out as left-to-right text: the full stop lands on the wrong side and sentences start mid-line
where: Activity, Table Talk on profiles, anywhere user text is shown
steps: As Maya open Activity
Read the notes written in Hebrew
expected: A line that starts in Hebrew is right-aligned and right-to-left; a line that starts in English stays left-to-right.
actual: The note "מי שמביאה עוגה מנצחת. זה לא הוגן." is left-aligned with its final full stop drawn at the right end, next to the first word. Mixed notes start in the middle of the line. The paragraph has no dir attribute and computes to direction: ltr, text-align: left; the page is <html lang="en"> with no dir.
why_it_matters: The app is for Israeli Whist and the demo groups are full of Hebrew names, session titles and notes; misplaced punctuation is the first thing a Hebrew reader sees.
evidence: eval on the note paragraph: { "tag": "P", "dirAttr": null, "direction": "ltr", "unicodeBidi": "isolate", "textAlign": "left", "htmlDir": "", "htmlLang": "en" }
suggested_fix: Add dir="auto" (and text-align: start) to every element that prints user-entered text: note body, player name, group name, session name, location. No other layout change is needed.

title: Type: eleven sizes with a crowded bottom end (9, 10, 11, 12 px) and three different page-title styles
steps: Collect computed font-size / weight / transform of every visible text node on each screen
expected: A short scale (five or six steps), nothing functional under 12 px, one page-title style.
actual: Sizes in use: 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20, 24, 30 px (plus 48/60 px glyphs); weights 400, 500, 600, 700. 10 px carries real information: tab-bar labels, the session delta "↑ +35", "Round 4 · step 2 of 2" (also only 4.42:1), RENEGE, OPEN/CLOSED/UP/DOWN badges, stat-card labels, the chart axis title; the unread badge is 9 px; award descriptions are 11 px; the rules chat is the only 15 px and the only weight 600. Page titles come in three styles: 24 px uppercase tracked ("SESSIONS", "HISTORY", "PICK THE TABLE", "GROUP ADMIN"), a large sentence-case session name ("Midweek special"), 20 px sentence case ("Round 10", "Edit Round 10"), plus 18 px uppercase inside the phase banner. Uppercase is on the header title, page titles, section labels, form labels, stat labels, badges and dialog titles at once. The landing tagline is 12 px with 3.6 px letter-spacing and breaks onto three lines at 320 px.
why_it_matters: When six kinds of text shout in capitals none of them leads, and 10 px numbers (the session delta) are hard to read at arm's length.
evidence: eval (group home): "24px/700 uppercase ls0.6px … \"Sessions\"", "18px/700 … \"Standings\"", "16px/700 uppercase … \"Thursday Whist\"", "12px/500 uppercase … \"Active session\"", "11px/400 … \"Most points lost taking too \"", "10px/500 uppercase … \"Open\"", "10px/500 … \"+35\""

eval (groups list): "10px/500 … \"Groups\"", "9px/700 … \"9+\""; (profile) "30px/700 uppercase … \"Dan\"", "10px/400 uppercase ls0.25px x12 e.g. \"Total Score\""; (rules) "18px/600 … \"WhistMate Rules\"", "15px/400 x3"
suggested_fix: Scale: 12 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 24 (+30 for the profile name). Minimum 12 px for anything read as data (delta, step counter, tab labels, stat labels); badges 11 px bold. Page title: one style — 24 px / 700, sentence case, no tracking ("Sessions", "Pick the table", "Round 10"). Keep uppercase for two things only: the header group name and 12 px section labels. Landing tagline: letter-spacing 1.5 px so it fits two lines at 320 px.

title: Gold is not rationed: on one screen it is logo, button, selected option, score, badge, link, icon and status at the same time
where: Groups list, Group Admin, New Session, select lists, player profile
steps: Open the groups list as Maya
Open Admin and look at the Group Settings card
Open the session dropdown in the note dialog
expected: Solid gold marks the one primary action on a screen; selection and data use a quieter treatment.
actual: Groups list: ten gold elements in one view (logo tile, wordmark, stats icon, total score, Create Group, two group initials, two group scores, active tab; plus the 9+ badge). Admin: the selected scoring method ("Classic") and "Save Settings" are both solid gold bars of the same height 150 px apart, then "Share Invite Link" is a third; on New Session the selected "Progressive" sits above the gold "Start Session". The selected row of a dropdown is a full-width solid gold bar. "Claimed", "Advanced", "Admin", "All history →", "Open round →" are gold text. "Leave a Note" is a full-width gold primary at the very end of a profile. The tinted variant (gold at 20% on navy) turns a muddy olive on avatars, feature icons and the OPEN / PLAYING / ARCHIVED / EVERYONE FELL / YOU badges — one badge colour for five unrelated meanings.
why_it_matters: Selected and "press me" look identical, so the eye cannot find the action; and the accent loses its pull exactly where it is needed (Save, Start, Resume).
suggested_fix: Rule: one solid-gold element per view = the primary action. Selected segment / dropdown row: background #1F2B47, 1.5 px gold border, gold text, check icon (the table picker already does this well). Group initial tiles: background #1F2B47, white letter. "Leave a Note": outline button. Status badges: OPEN / PLAYING = gold tint; ARCHIVED and EVERYONE FELL = neutral (#1F2B47, #9FA9BC text); "Claimed" = green check with muted text. Replace the 20%-gold tint (which reads olive on navy) with a neutral chip — background #2A3350, gold text — wherever a gold-tinted surface is still wanted.

title: Form controls: input outlines at 1.1:1, two input heights, three label styles, an invisible off-switch and a black date icon
where: Login / register, Create Group and other dialogs, New Session, Group Admin, verification code
steps: Compare the fields on Login, in the Create Group dialog and on New Session
Read computed border and background colours with eval
expected: One input component: visible edge (3:1 against its surround), one height, one label style; switches and native pickers readable on navy.
actual: Input border #222F4F on the card #182749 is 1.11:1 (1.26:1 on the page colour) — fields are found by their placeholder, not their shape. Inputs are 48 px high with a leading icon on the auth screens and 36 px without one everywhere else. Labels: 14 px/500 white sentence case on Login and New Session, 12 px/500 muted uppercase in dialogs and Admin — and in Admin the card title "GROUP SETTINGS" has exactly the same style as the field label "GROUP NAME" under it. The switch in its off state is a #0E1D3E thumb on a #222F4F track (1.26:1), 36x20 px. The date field shows the browser's black calendar icon on navy (computed color-scheme: normal). Errors appear in a tinted box on Login but as bare red text in the Join dialog. The keypad keys (#1F2B47) are 1.05:1 against their card.
why_it_matters: Low-contrast fields and switches slow down every form; the mixed styles make dialogs feel like a different app from the sign-in screens.
evidence: eval (login): { "inputBorder": "rgb(34, 47, 79)", "inputH": 48, "cardBg": "rgb(24, 39, 73)" }; (dialog) "340x36 @25,332 input \"e.g. Tuesday Whist Club\"", label { "size": "12px", "weight": "500", "tt": "uppercase" }
suggested_fix: Input: height 48 px, background #0E1D3E, border 1px #46557A (3:1 on #182749), radius 12 px, 16 px text; focus = 2 px gold ring. Label: 14 px/500 #F2F4F7 sentence case everywhere; card titles 16 px/700 white so they outrank labels. Switch: 52x32 px, off = track #46557A with a #F2F4F7 thumb, on = gold track with a navy thumb. Add color-scheme: dark on :root so native date/select pickers render light-on-dark. One error component (the tinted box from Login) used in dialogs too. Keypad keys: background #2A3A63 (about 1.5:1 on the card) or a 1px #46557A border.

title: Buttons: three heights, three label casings, and a pressed state that turns "Regenerate Code" into white text on gold (1.27:1)
where: Landing, login, groups list, session, round entry, admin
steps: Compare the main button on each screen
In Admin tap "Regenerate Code" and look at the button afterwards
On the groups list tap "Join Group" and look behind the dialog
expected: One button family with defined sizes and one casing; pressed/hover states keep the label readable and do not stick after a touch.
actual: Primary buttons are 36 px high (Create Group, Save Round, Lock Bids, Start Round, Save Settings — measured), about 48 px (Log in, Create account, SIGN IN / SIGN UP — from the screenshots) or about 60 px (RESUME ROUND 4, START ROUND 1, START NEW SESSION — from the screenshots). Labels are UPPERCASE bold tracked on the hero buttons, "Sentence case" on Log in, "Title Case" on Create Group / Save Round / Lock Bids. After a touch the hover style stays on: "Regenerate Code" (a ghost button) sits on a solid gold background with its near-white label, rgb(242,244,247) on rgb(253,216,53) = 1.27:1; the outline "Join Group" stays filled gold behind its dialog; the fifth player tapped on a full table keeps a half-gold border. Keyboard focus on a gold button is a 1 px gold ring on gold — not visible. "Save Settings" gives no visible confirmation at all (no message, no label change); the copy button, by contrast, turns into a check.
why_it_matters: The most important button of the core flow (Save Round, 36 px) is visually weaker than a navigation shortcut (Resume, 60 px), and a button whose label disappears after a tap looks broken.
evidence: browser tool after tapping Save Settings: "LISTING unchanged, but the page itself changed in a way the markup does not expose"
suggested_fix: Sizes: md 44 px (secondary, dialogs), lg 52 px (step actions: Save Round, Lock Bids, Start Round, Start Session, Save Settings), xl 60 px (one hero CTA per screen). Casing: sentence case 16 px/600 everywhere; drop the uppercase+tracking variant. Wrap hover styles in @media (hover: hover) and give touch a :active state (gold at 90%, scale .98); ghost hover = background #1F2B47, never gold. Focus-visible: 2 px ring #F2F4F7 with 2 px offset so it shows on gold. Saving: the button reads "Saved ✓" for 2 s (or a small toast above the tab bar).

title: At 320 px the phase title is cut to "BIDD…" / "R…", action rows overrun the gutter and history lines wrap badly
where: Bidding and Results banners, groups list, scored round, History — small 320x568
steps: Switch to the small preset and open the round in play, the groups list, a scored round and History
expected: Titles fit; rows keep the 16 px gutter; meta lines wrap as whole items.
actual: The banner title truncates: "BIDD…" (62.9 px box for 78 px of text) and, on Results, "R…", because the "Round 5 · step 2 of 2" label and the counter chip share the row. On the groups list "Join Group" ends at x=310.3 while the cards end at 304; on the scored round "Delete Round" ends about 12 px past the cards. In History the "Rematch" line breaks into "Nov 5, / 2026" and "12 / rounds" with a shrunken pin icon. On the landing page the main button spans y=525–573 on a 568 px screen (cut by the fold).
why_it_matters: Small phones are still in use; a title reduced to one letter and buttons that poke out of the column look careless.
suggested_fix: Banner: put "Round 5 · step 2 of 2" on its own line under the title below 360 px (flex-wrap; title flex-shrink: 0). Button pairs: grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0,1fr)) with gap 8 px instead of intrinsic widths; drop the icon under 360 px. History meta: flex-wrap: wrap with white-space: nowrap per item and flex-shrink: 0 on icons. Landing: reduce the hero tile to 88 px under 600 px of height so the button clears the fold.

title: Two back arrows are stacked on every inner screen, and the top one is an unlabelled 16 px icon
where: Session, round, player profile, admin, new session — inside a group, phone
steps: Open a session as Maya on the phone preset and look at the top 110 px
expected: One clear way back per screen, labelled with where it goes.
actual: The header has a muted 16x16 "←" (it leaves the group and goes to the groups list); 70 px below, the page has a second "← Sessions" / "← Session" / "← Back" / "← Back to Games" (four different labels; "Games" is used nowhere else — the tab is "Sessions"). On desktop the header arrow gains the label "Groups", so the meaning is only visible there.
why_it_matters: Two identical arrows with different destinations is a classic wrong-exit trap; the one that throws you out of the group is the one without a label.
suggested_fix: Header left slot: a 44x44 "grid / switch group" icon (or the small spade tile) labelled for screen readers "All groups" — not an arrow. Keep exactly one in-page back link, always "← <parent name>" (Sessions, Session, Player), 44 px high. Rename "Back to Games" to "← Sessions".

title: Player profile: the explanation bubble covers the number it explains, the stat grid leaves holes, and some 50 round rows bury Table Talk
steps: Open Dan's profile as Maya
Tap the label "TOTAL SCORE"
Scroll to the end of the page
expected: The explanation appears next to the stat; cards fill the grid; secondary lists are short or collapsed; the tab bar shows where I am.
actual: The bubble for TOTAL SCORE opens over the value (+771 is hidden) and starts at x=0, outside the 16 px gutter. PERFORMANCE has 5 cards and STRATEGY and AWARDS 3 each in a 2-column grid, leaving three empty half-rows. Round history lists some 50 rounds as separate cards — the page is 5,227 px tall (4,383 px of scroll on an 844 px screen) — and only after it come the gold "Leave a Note" button and TABLE TALK. The "Profile" tab is lit while I am looking at someone else's profile. On my own profile the "VIEW ANOTHER PLAYER" field is an empty box with a chevron. The chart axis says "Games played" while every other label says "rounds". Stat labels are tappable but are 18 px-high targets marked only by a dotted underline.
why_it_matters: The profile is the reward screen of a stats tracker; these are the rough edges people will see when they show it to the table.
evidence: look output: "VIEW phone 390x844 · scrolled 0/4383px"; eval: "72x18 @50,-4136 button \"TOTAL SCORE\"", "16px/700 x50 e.g. \"+14\""
suggested_fix: Bubble: anchor below the card (side="bottom", collisionPadding 16) or turn the card into an expanding row with the text under the value. Grid: make the last odd card span both columns (grid-column: 1 / -1) or use 3 columns for the 3-card groups. Round history: show the last 5 with "Show all 114 rounds"; move Table Talk above it. Tab bar: light "Profile" only on /profile; on another player keep "Sessions" lit. Select: placeholder "Choose a player". Axis: "Rounds played". Stat labels: add a small ⓘ and make the whole card the target.

title: One player, three avatars — and the Hebrew initial "י" makes the avatar look empty
where: Standings, table picker, player profile, groups list
steps: Compare Dan in Standings, in "Pick the table" and on his profile
Look at יוסי in Standings and on his profile
expected: A player has one avatar colour everywhere; every avatar shows a readable mark.
actual: Dan is a cyan letter on a teal-blue circle in Standings, a grey letter on a grey circle in the table picker and a gold letter on an olive circle on his profile. The standings palette (blue, teal, cyan, green, rose) is the only place these hues exist; two of them fall under 4.5:1 ("M" 4.26:1, rose letters 4.34:1). For יוסי the initial is the letter yod, which renders as a short tick — at 36 px and even at 56 px on the profile the circle looks blank.
why_it_matters: Avatars are how people find themselves in a list at a glance; changing colours break that, and an empty circle looks like a loading failure.
suggested_fix: One Avatar component with the colour derived from the member id, used in Standings, picker (unselected = same colour at 60% opacity), profile and notes. Lighten the letters to the 300 step of each hue (e.g. #93C5FD, #FDA4AF) for ≥4.5:1. Initials: use the first two letters for Hebrew names ("יו", "אב", "נו") or, when the first glyph is י / ו / ' , take two.

title: Several icons say something other than their label (trophy = History, house = Groups, crown = The Coward)
where: Tab bars, group Awards, groups list
steps: Read the tab bar inside a group and on the groups list
Read the Awards cards on the group home
expected: Each icon would still be understood with its label removed.
actual: Inside a group the "History" tab is a trophy (reads as awards or leaderboard — and Standings/Awards actually live under "Sessions"). On the top level "Groups" is a house and "Profile" is a globe with a person, while inside a group "Profile" is a plain person. The award "The Coward" carries a crown, the usual sign for a winner. The "9+" unread badge is 20.5x16 px with 9 px text and covers about half of the Activity icon. The "Sessions" tab is an outlined spade — fine as a brand touch, but it is the same glyph the empty states use.
why_it_matters: Tab icons are read before labels (labels are 10 px); a trophy that opens a list of dates sets the wrong expectation.
suggested_fix: History → clock-with-arrow ("history") icon; Groups → people ("users") icon; Profile → the same person icon on both levels (the page title "Global stats" already explains the scope); The Coward → a rabbit / shield-off / feather icon, keep the crown for a real "winner" stat. Badge: 18 px circle offset top −4 px, right −10 px so the icon stays visible, 11 px text.

title: Two card styles and three badge styles are mixed on the same screen
steps: Compare Standings rows with the session / award / round cards on the group home
Compare the badges OPEN, CLOSED, UP, Admin, ANON
expected: One card surface per level; one badge shape with a small set of colours.
actual: Standings rows and stat tiles are borderless fills (#1F2B47, padding 12 px); session, award, round and chart cards are #182749 with a 1px #253356 border (padding 16 px for sessions, 12 px for awards). Both use radius 14 px, which holds the look together, but the screen alternates between "filled" and "outlined" lists for no stated reason. Badges: uppercase 10 px pills (OPEN, CLOSED, UP, DOWN, PLAYING, ANON, YOU), a sentence-case 12 px pill ("Admin"), and plain bold text ("UP" on the round page, "Advanced" in gold text in History). In History 14 of 15 cards carry the same grey CLOSED badge.
why_it_matters: Small inconsistencies add up to a "generic dashboard" feel; a single card and badge recipe would make the app look designed rather than assembled.
suggested_fix: Card = #182749 + 1px #253356, radius 14 px, padding 16 px, used for every tappable row including Standings; reserve the borderless #1F2B47 fill for non-tappable tiles (stats) and inner chips. Badge = pill, 11 px/700 uppercase, height 22 px, three variants only: accent (gold tint), neutral (#1F2B47 / #9FA9BC), danger (red tint). In History show the badge only when a session is OPEN.

title: Empty and error states come in five different looks, and a new session shows two of them at once
where: Groups list (new user), Activity (new user), new session, missing session, missing player
steps: Sign up as a new user and open Groups, Activity and Profile
Create a session and open it before any round
Open /session/doesnotexist123 and /player/nope123 as Maya
expected: One empty-state component (icon, title, one line, optional button) and one error component.
actual: (1) Groups / Global profile: muted line icon in a 64 px circle, UPPERCASE 18 px title. (2) Activity: a glossy system emoji 💬 with a Title Case 20 px title — the only emoji illustration in the app. (3) New session: a solid white ♠ with "No Rounds Yet / Play a session to see standings." and, 300 px lower, the same white ♠ with "No rounds yet / Start the first round above." — two near-identical blocks, different capitalisation, filling two screens. (4) Missing session: a red-outlined box "Session not found" with a "Try Again" button (retrying cannot help). (5) Missing player: white ♠, "Player Not Found", a gold text link "Back". The loading screen, by contrast, is consistent and on-brand everywhere.
why_it_matters: First-run and error moments are where a product earns trust; five looks read as five authors.
suggested_fix: EmptyState component = the Groups version (64 px circle #1F2B47 with a 28 px muted icon, 18 px/700 sentence-case title, 14 px muted line, optional 44 px button). Activity: message-circle icon instead of the emoji. New session: one block under the CTA ("No rounds yet — start round 1 above") and hide the Standings and Rounds headings until there is data. Not-found screens: the same component with the title "This session was deleted or the link is wrong" and a "Back to sessions" button; drop "Try Again" for 404s and the red frame.

title: Sign-in screens have no breathing room on short screens (logo touches the top edge)
where: Login at 320x568; Create account at 390x844; landing at 320x568
steps: Open /login in the small preset
Open /register in the phone preset
expected: At least 24 px above the logo and below the last link at every supported size.
actual: Login at 320x568: the logo tile starts at y=0 (document 734 px tall, content centred with no minimum padding). Register at 390x844: the tile starts at y=3 and the "Log in" link ends at 839 of 844 — the content fills the screen edge to edge. The logo block (112 px tile + wordmark + title + subtitle) takes about 300 px before the first field.
why_it_matters: First impression screens; with the keyboard open on a real phone the form is pushed further and the tile is the thing that gets clipped.
suggested_fix: Wrapper: min-height: 100dvh; padding: 32px 16px; justify-content: safe center (or margin: auto on the inner block) so overflow goes downward. Under 700 px of height shrink the tile to 64 px and drop the subtitle line.

title: Group Admin order and weight: Danger Zone sits above Members, and the member list is a column of red "Remove" buttons
steps: Open Admin as Maya and scroll from top to bottom
expected: Frequent tasks first (members, invite), settings next, destructive group actions last and quietest until needed.
actual: Order is Group Settings → Invite Code → DANGER ZONE → Members. To rename or add a player an admin scrolls past Archive and Delete every time. Each of six member cards ends with a red "Remove" (six red labels on one scroll), with "Make Admin" and "Unclaim" as equal-weight neighbours.
why_it_matters: The red frame loses its warning value when it is in the daily path, and it is exactly where the unconfirmed Archive button lives.
evidence: look output order: "## GROUP SETTINGS … ## INVITE CODE … ## DANGER ZONE … ## MEMBERS (7)"
suggested_fix: Order: Members → Invite code → Group settings → Danger zone (last, collapsed behind a "Show" row). Member card: name row with a "⋯" 44x44 menu holding Rename / Make admin / Unclaim / Remove (Remove in red inside the menu), instead of three inline buttons.

title: Opening an invite link shows a dialog floating over an empty black screen
where: /join?code=… as a signed-in user with no groups
steps: Open the invite link as newbie@example.com
Tap Continue
expected: A page that says where I am: WhistMate mark, the group's name as the hero, then the choice of player.
actual: Both steps ("JOIN A GROUP", "JOINING THURSDAY WHIST") are the square dialog band over a black scrim; the page behind is blank, so three quarters of the screen is black with no logo. In step 2 the two claimable players are 336 px wide and "I'm a new player" is 340 px wide (right edges 361 vs 365).
why_it_matters: This is the first screen most players will ever see (they arrive by link, not by store); it should be the warmest one.
evidence: eval: ["אבי 25-361 h46", "יוסי 25-361 h46", "I'm a new player 25-365 h46", "Back 25-365 h36", "Join Group 25-365 h36"]
suggested_fix: Make /join a full page on the navy background: 64 px spade tile, "You're invited to", group name at 24 px/700, member count, then the player choices as full-width 52 px rows on cards and the gold "Join group" button in the sticky action bar. Give all option rows the same width (remove the inner scroll container's gutter).

title: On desktop the app is a 640 px phone column with the phone tab bar stretched across 1440 px; the rules assistant alone goes full width
steps: Open groups, group home, results entry, bidding and the rules assistant in the desktop preset
expected: Either a deliberate "phone frame" or a layout that uses the width; the same container on every screen.
actual: Content sits in a 640 px column (max-width 672 px) with 400 px of empty navy on each side; text stays 12–14 px. The bottom tab bar spans the full 1440 px with 10 px labels; the menu is still a hamburger. Results/bidding keys grow to about 82x82 px squares. A helper sentence on the bidding screen runs about 113 characters on one line of small text. The rules assistant ignores the column: header at the far left, composer 1,356 px wide.
why_it_matters: Desktop is secondary for a table-side tool, so this is polish — but an admin setting up a group on a laptop sees a stretched phone.
suggested_fix: From 1024 px: replace the bottom tab bar with a left rail (220 px: mark, group name, Sessions / History / Profile / Admin with 14 px labels); content max-width 960 px in two columns on the group home (sessions + awards left, standings right) and on round entry (players left, keypad + action right, keys capped at 56 px). Body text 15–16 px, max line length 70ch. Put the rules assistant in the same container (max-width 720 px, centred).

title: Idea: give it a little more "card table" without changing the identity
steps: Go through a whole round on the phone preset and ask what tells you this is a card game
expected: A few card-table cues carried by components that already exist.
actual: Apart from the spade mark, the suit buttons and the words, the screens could belong to any dark dashboard: rounded navy cards, gold numbers, pill badges. The phase banners (gold for bidding, green for results) are the most characterful element.
why_it_matters: Feel is what makes a group prefer this to a notes app; a small amount goes a long way and the navy/gold/spade identity already points there.
suggested_fix: Three small, concrete touches: (1) show trump as a miniature playing card — a 24x32 px chip, background #F5F1E6, radius 4 px, the suit glyph in #D63A3A (♥ ♦) or #0E1D3E (♠ ♣), "NT" in navy — wherever trump appears (rounds list, round page, bidding row). (2) Mark the session leader: a small gold spade in place of "#1" in Standings and a "Winner" line on closed sessions. (3) Use the table metaphor in the picker: seats 1–4 drawn around a rounded navy "table" outline once four players are chosen, showing bidding order clockwise.

title: Idea: in History, say who won instead of repeating "CLOSED"
where: History, Recent sessions on the group home
steps: Open History as Maya
expected: Each past session answers the question people ask about it: who won, by how much.
actual: Fifteen cards of name, date, place, round count and a grey CLOSED badge; the result of the night is one tap deeper.
why_it_matters: History is bragging rights — the landing page promises exactly that.
suggested_fix: Replace the CLOSED badge with the winner on the right of the card: avatar 24 px + name 14 px/500 + score in gold 14 px/700 ("Maya +143"); keep a badge only for OPEN.

title: Idea: show "made / missed" as tricks are typed in
steps: Enter tricks equal to the bid for one player and different from the bid for another
expected: Immediate feedback per player, before saving.
actual: The typed number is plain white whether it matches the bid or not; the counter chip turns green at 13/13, which works well, but each row stays neutral until the round is saved.
why_it_matters: The scorer reads results aloud; a tick or a miss per row catches a typo before it becomes a score.
suggested_fix: When a value is entered: if tricks = bid show a 16 px green check and the projected score in gold at the right of the row ("+26"); otherwise show the projected penalty in the red text token ("−10"). Also turn the "14 / 13 tricks" chip to the red tint when the total is over 13.

title: An unfinished session is already counted as a "win" for whoever leads it
where: Session screen standings (/session/<id>), group home standings (/), player profile WIN RATE tile (/player/<id>)
steps: Sign in as Maya, open the open session 'Midweek special' and read the standings rows
Play rounds until the leader changes and read the rows again
Close the session, note the leader's wins on the group home
Start a new session, play rounds, and read the group home and the leader's profile while it is still open
expected: Rulebook section 5: 'Winning a session: the player with the highest total when the session closes.' An open session gives nobody a win; wins and win rate count closed sessions only.
actual: Open session: 'נועה · 3 rounds · 1 win'; after the lead changed: 'יוסי · 15 rounds · 1 win' and 'נועה · 15 rounds · 0 wins'; one round later the win was back with נועה. Group home: 'נועה 106 rounds · 4 wins' while Midweek special was open and she led it, 'נועה 119 rounds · 4 wins' after it closed with her in first place, then 'נועה 130 rounds · 5 wins' while the next session was still open. Her profile: 'WIN RATE 42% · 5 wins', 'ROUNDS 130 · 12 sessions'. A brand-new session after one round: 'נועה · 1 round · 1 win'.
why_it_matters: Players read 'wins' as nights won. The number goes up and down hand by hand during the evening and the win rate includes a night nobody has won yet, so the headline stat cannot be trusted.
evidence: tool output: '[6] link "#1 י יוסי 15 rounds · 1 win · +7.6 avg +114"' / '[7] link "#2 נ נועה 15 rounds · 0 wins · +7.07 avg +106"'
tool output on / with the session still open: '[5] #1 | נ | נועה 130 rounds · 5 wins · +10.92 avg'
suggested_fix: Count wins, win rate and podiums from closed sessions only. Inside a session's own standings drop the 'wins' figure (or show 'leading').

title: A started round cannot be discarded, and the session cannot be closed while it exists
where: Bidding and results steps (/round/<id>), session screen (/session/<id>)
steps: Open a session, tap START ROUND, pick four players, tap Start Round
Look for any way to cancel the round on the bidding step and on the results step
Go back to the session screen and look for Close Session
expected: A round started by mistake (wrong four, wrong order, a misdeal, the night ending mid-hand) can be discarded, and the session can then be closed.

The session screen shows 'RESUME ROUND 13' and 'Round 13 | BIDDING | Open round →'; the Close Session button is absent. The only way out is to enter made-up bids and tricks, save, open the round and use Delete Round.
why_it_matters: Misdeals and wrong picks happen every night. The scorer is stuck with a phantom round and cannot end the evening without typing invented numbers into the record.
evidence: tool output, every control on the in-play bidding step: '[1] button (no label) icon=arrow-left', '[2] button "Menu"', '[3] button "Session"', four player rows, four 'Mark as trump winner', '[26] button "Lock Bids" disabled', bottom navigation
tool output, session page searched for close/delete/discard/cancel/abandon: only '[5] link "RESUME ROUND 13"' and '[16] link "Open round →"'
tool output: 'ERROR no visible element matches "Close Session"'
suggested_fix: Add 'Discard round' on the bidding and results steps (with a confirm), and keep Close Session available, offering to discard the unfinished round.

title: The last-bidder hint is reordered next to a Hebrew name: it reads 'Bid for 2 · נועה blocked'

suggested_fix: Wrap every player name the app places inside a sentence in a direction-isolating element (<bdi>), here and in 'Tricks for …', 'Trump won by …', 'won by …', 'left a note about …'.

title: Hebrew free text (notes, session name, location) is laid out left-to-right, so mixed sentences are scrambled

title: The Destroyer names one player for what is always a tie, and the name changes between visits
where: Group home Awards (/), profile THE DESTROYER tile
steps: Open Family Table: three sessions, one everyone-falls round (Holiday table, round 3) with all four players in it
Read the Awards block
Open Thursday Whist, read The Destroyer, come back a few minutes later and read it again

title: The order of a hand in the app is not the order at the table; nothing tracks the dealer or who speaks first
where: PICK THE TABLE (/session/<id>/round/new) and the bidding step
steps: Finish a round, tap START ROUND, tap 'Same players as last round'
Read the order numbers on the four players
On the bidding step, look for the dealer, the first bidder, and where trump is entered
expected: The first bidder moves on every hand (the seeded rounds 1–4 of the same session do rotate: Maya, Dan, נועה, יוסי in turn). Trump is settled by the auction before the final contracts, and the declarer states the contract first.

suggested_fix: Make 'Same players' rotate the first seat by one and show who deals. Ask 'who won the auction, and in which suit?' first, then take the contracts starting from that player.

title: UP/DOWN, renege, everyone falls and hierarchy are not explained on the screens where a new member meets them

On the results step look at the RENEGE pill on each row and tap one
Save a round nobody made and look at the round card

The only explanation is the chat under Menu → Ask About the Game.

suggested_fix: Make the UP/DOWN badge and the EVERYONE FELL badge open a two-line explanation; label the pill 'Renege −100'; add one line under Advanced rules naming the two hierarchies; link 'Ask about the game' from the bidding step without leaving it.

title: Bids and tricks that are typed but not yet saved disappear without warning
steps: Start a round, enter four bids (4/4/3/5, badge 'UP · 16'), do not lock
Go to the group home, come back through RESUME ROUND

title: The trump record accepts a winner who did not bid highest, and pre-fills the first of several tied bidders
steps: Enter bids 1 / 6 / 7 / 2
Tap the trump slot on the row of the player who bid 1 and choose ♠
Tap Lock Bids
In an Advanced session enter bids 5 / 5 / 2 / 3 and read the trump line

title: Advanced rules: the hierarchy choice has no label, blocks Lock Bids silently, and is not shown during play
where: Bidding step in an Advanced session; results step header
steps: Start a session with Advanced rules on, start a round, enter four bids, choose a trump suit
Scroll down to Lock Bids
Choose Down-Up, lock, and read the header of the results step

The results header reads 'Table UP · trump ♥ Hearts · won by Maya' with no hierarchy; it appears only later on the round page: 'Trump ♥ Hearts · won by Maya · Down-Up (A,2,3…K)'.

title: Cancelled (everyone-falls) rounds still count as rounds played and pull the average down
where: Session standings, group standings, profile AVG / ROUND and CONTRACT ACCURACY
steps: Play a session with seven scored rounds and one everyone-falls round
Read the round count and the average in the standings

title: Wording on the game screens that is not a player's wording
where: Bidding step, Edit bids note, results header, round cards, New Session form, empty session, group home

title: 0-BID SUCCESS shows 0% for a player who never bid zero

Nobody is rewarded or penalized, except for a renege penalty, which still applies.' The content matches rulebook section 4.4; the language is not the asker's.

title: The assistant's refusal is flippant and a dead end; one answer leaves out the progressive tiers
where: Rules assistant (real answers transcript, and the sandbox chat)
steps: Ask: How do I delete my account?
Ask: What is progressive scoring? Show me what I lose if I miss by 5.

Minus signs are written two ways across answers ('−50' and '-50').

title: Suit symbols lose their order and colour in places

title: Small phone and long text: title cut, pad below the fold, session card line wraps badly

title: Invite link forgets the invite once the person signs in or signs up

steps: Sign in as Maya (http://localhost:4606/?access_token=sbx-maya), open /home and tap "Thursday Whist" (Maya is admin there, plain player in Family Table).

evidence: ! http 403 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/updateRound — {"error":"Only a group admin can edit a past round"}
suggested_fix: When a session/round/player page loads, set the active group from the record's own group (and the role from that membership) before rendering.

title: New Session form ignores the group's default scoring after a reload or direct open — the session is then frozen with the wrong method
steps: Sign in as Maya, open /home, tap "Family Table" (its default scoring is Progressive), tap "START NEW SESSION": Progressive is preselected.
Reload the page (or open http://localhost:4606/session/new directly).
Tap "Start Session".
expected: Progressive (and the group's Advanced-rules default) preselected every time; the form itself says "Defaults come from the group".
actual: After the reload Classic is selected and Advanced is off. The session is created as "Open · Classic". Same in Thursday Whist after saving Progressive + Advanced as group defaults. The rules are "frozen for the whole session" and there is no way to edit or delete a session.
why_it_matters: Phones reload tabs all the time. A whole evening can be scored with the wrong penalty table, and the only cure is to close the session and start again.
evidence: After Start Session: "# Whist Night / Nov 18, 2026 · Open · Classic" in Family Table (default Progressive)
suggested_fix: Initialise the form only after the group has loaded (or re-apply defaults when it arrives, unless the user already touched the controls).

title: A round started by mistake cannot be cancelled, and it blocks closing the session
steps: As Maya in Thursday Whist, open the open session and tap "START ROUND n".
Pick four players (for example a wrong one) and tap "Start Round (4/4)".
Look for a way to cancel the round or change the players; go back to the session and look for "Close Session".
expected: A "Cancel round" / "Change players" action while the round is in play, and either a Close Session button or a line saying why it is missing.
actual: The bidding and results screens offer only bids, trump, "Lock Bids" / "Edit bids" / "Save Round". The session page has no "Close Session" while a round is in play and says nothing about it. The only way out is to type made-up bids and tricks, save, then delete the round — and only a group admin can delete; a plain player has no exit at all.
why_it_matters: Picking the wrong fourth player is an easy slip (a fifth tap is ignored silently). The table is then stuck with a phantom round, and fake numbers must be saved to get rid of it.
evidence: Round in play, session page controls: [5] link "RESUME ROUND 5", [10] link "Open round →", [15]-[17] "Edit round" — no "Close Session" (it is listed as [18] button "Close Session" as soon as no round is in play)
Bidding screen controls: "Mark as trump winner" x4, 0-13, [26] button "Lock Bids" disabled — nothing else
suggested_fix: Add "Cancel this round" on both steps of a round in play (for whoever can start one), and show a disabled Close Session with the reason.

title: Admin errors appear far from the button that caused them, so failed actions look like nothing happened
steps: As Maya open Thursday Whist → Admin.
Scroll to the last member, tap its pencil, type "Dan" (a name that exists), tap the check mark.
Scroll to the top, clear GROUP NAME, tap "Save Settings".
expected: A message next to the field or button that failed.
actual: Rename: the server answers 409 and the editor just stays open; the message is rendered at the top of the MEMBERS list, off-screen. Save Settings: the server answers 400 "Group name cannot be empty"; the message is rendered below the Invite Code card, off-screen. A successful Save Settings shows no confirmation either.
why_it_matters: An admin cannot tell whether a rename or a settings change was saved.
evidence: ! http 409 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/renameMember — {"error":"A member named \"Dan\" already exists in this group"}
! http 400 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/updateGroupSettings — {"error":"Group name cannot be empty"}
suggested_fix: Show each error inline in the card or section that triggered it (or as a toast), and confirm a successful save.

title: Two players can have the same name in different letter case (Dan / dan / DAN)
where: Join dialog ("I'm a new player"), Admin → Add player
steps: As newbie open http://localhost:4606/join?code=NHUA1B&access_token=sbx-newbie, Continue, "I'm a new player", type "dan " , Join Group.
As Maya in Admin tap Add, type "MAYA", Add Player.
Start a round in Thursday Whist and look at the player picker.
expected: Refused like the exact duplicate is ("A member named \"Dan\" already exists in this group").
actual: Both are accepted. The picker then shows "D dan", "D Dan", "D DAN" side by side with the same avatar letter.
why_it_matters: Scores get entered for the wrong 'Dan'.
evidence: Exact duplicate is refused: ! http 409 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/joinGroupByCode — {"error":"A member named \"Dan\" already exists in this group. Try a different display name."}
suggested_fix: Compare names case-insensitively (and trimmed) in join, add and rename.

title: 'Remove' on a member does three different things and explains none of them
steps: As Maya in Thursday Whist Admin, tap Remove → Confirm on Rachel (claimed, 79 rounds).
Rachel is still listed, now "Unclaimed". Tap Remove → Confirm on her again.
expected: The confirm step says what will happen; Remove is not offered where it can never work.
actual: First Remove silently detaches Rachel's account and keeps the player. Second Remove fails with "\"Rachel\" has game history and cannot be removed. Ghost members with history stay on the roster." (shown at the top of the list). 'Ghost member' is not a word the app uses anywhere else; a demoted admin also sees "Only group admins can add ghost members".
why_it_matters: An admin cannot predict whether Remove deletes a person, their account link, or nothing.
evidence: ! http 400 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/removeMember — {"error":"\"Rachel\" has game history and cannot be removed. Ghost members with history stay on the roster."}
suggested_fix: Label the confirm ("Rachel keeps her history and becomes an unclaimed player"), hide Remove for players with history, and say 'player without an account' instead of 'ghost'.

title: Archive, Regenerate Code and app-level Make Admin act on one tap, with no confirmation
steps: As Maya in Thursday Whist Admin tap "Regenerate Code" once.
Tap "Archive" once.
As Root on /app-admin tap "Make Admin" next to any user.
expected: A confirmation, as Delete Group, Delete Round and Close Session have.
actual: The code changes at once (NHUA1B → UXQICS) and the old code/link is dead ("Invalid invite code"). The group is archived at once (button turns into "Unarchive"), even with a session open. The user becomes an app admin at once. No dialog was raised for any of the three.
why_it_matters: One slip of the thumb in the Danger Zone makes the group read-only for everyone, or kills every invite link already sent.
evidence: After one tap on Regenerate Code: [10] input ... value="UXQICS" readonly; old code: ! http 404 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/previewGroupByCode — {"error":"Invalid invite code"}
After one tap on Archive: [14] button "Unarchive"; errors list: "OK nothing recorded since start — no console errors, exceptions, failed requests or dialogs"
suggested_fix: Ask for confirmation on Archive and Regenerate Code (say that old links stop working) and on granting app admin.

title: Starting a session while one is open throws the form away and jumps to the open session without a word
steps: As Maya in Thursday Whist ("Midweek special" is open) open http://localhost:4606/session/new.
Fill in a name, date and location, tap "Start Session".
expected: A message such as "Midweek special is still open — close it first", or no way to reach the form.
actual: You land on "Midweek special" with no message; what you typed is gone.
why_it_matters: The user believes a new session started and scores the new night into the old session.
evidence: #55 http 409 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/startSession — {"error":"A session is already open in this group","open_session_id":"001ca3e176b3422b4928e3db"}  [on /session/new]
suggested_fix: Show the 409 message with a link to the open session; on /session/new show the open session instead of the form.

title: Round numbers go wrong after a round is deleted
steps: As Maya in an open Thursday Whist session with rounds 1-4, open round 2 → "Delete Round" → OK.
Read the big button, tap it, start the round.
expected: The button and the new round carry the same number, and numbering has no surprises.
actual: The list shows Round 4, 3, 1. The button says "START ROUND 4"; the round it creates is "Round 5". Afterwards the button says "START ROUND 5" although Round 5 exists.
why_it_matters: People at the table refer to rounds by number when they dispute a score.
evidence: [5] link "START ROUND 4" → /session/001ca3e176b3422b4928e3db/round/new ... then: # BIDDING | Round 5 · step 1 of 2
Rounds list: Round 5 | BIDDING / Round 4 | UP / Round 3 | DOWN / Round 1 | UP
suggested_fix: Derive the button label from the same counter the server uses (highest number + 1), or renumber on delete.

title: Group Admin member cards overflow the screen (390 px when confirming, 320 px always)
steps: Phone 390 px: as Maya in Admin tap "Remove" (or "Unclaim") on a claimed member.
Small 320 px: open Admin and scroll to MEMBERS.
expected: Everything stays inside the card and the page does not scroll sideways.
actual: 390 px: Confirm/Cancel are pushed past the card edge ("Cance" / "Remov" clipped) and the page becomes wider than the screen. 320 px: the page is 364 px wide before anything is tapped; the bottom tab bar's Admin tab is cut off.
why_it_matters: The Cancel button of a destructive confirm is the one that is half off-screen.
evidence: eval at 320 px: document.documentElement.scrollWidth+' vs '+clientWidth → "364 vs 320"
suggested_fix: Let the action row wrap (flex-wrap) or show the confirm on its own line.

title: Session name, location and date accept anything: 360-character names, year 1900, an empty date that becomes yesterday
steps: As Maya start a session with a 360-character name without spaces, date 1900-01-01 and a 500-character location.
Separately: clear the Date field and start a session shortly after local midnight.
expected: Sensible limits (as group and player names have: 60 / 30 characters), a date in a sane range, and a blank date refused or set to today's local date.
actual: All accepted. The title runs off the right edge with no ellipsis and the page becomes 4858 px wide; on desktop it runs past the column. The blank date was saved as Nov 18, 2026 while the form's own default (local today) was 2026-11-19. Markup in the location is shown as text (good).
why_it_matters: A fat-fingered date or pasted text cannot be corrected later — sessions cannot be edited or deleted.
evidence: Blank date: "# Whist Night / Nov 18, 2026 · Open · Classic" (form default was value="2026-11-19")
suggested_fix: maxLength on name/location, wrap long titles (overflow-wrap:anywhere), require a date, and let an admin edit a session's name/date/location.

title: An archived group still offers every write action; they only fail at the last step
steps: As Maya archive Thursday Whist while a session is open.
Open the session: tap "START ROUND 2", pick four players, "Start Round".
Try "Edit round" → Save Changes, "Close Session", Admin → Add / Regenerate Code; as Dan in Old Crew delete one of your notes.
expected: Write buttons hidden or disabled with the read-only note, as the notes box already does ("This group is archived — new notes are disabled.").
actual: Every write is refused by the server with "This group is archived — it is read-only" (the rule holds), but only after the user has filled the form. Deleting a note fails with no message at all. The open session stays "OPEN" and cannot be closed. The home banner "This group is archived — read-only." is missing when the group has an active session.
why_it_matters: Read-only is correct but feels like the app is broken.
evidence: ! http 403 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/startRound — {"error":"This group is archived — it is read-only"}
! http 403 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/closeSession — {"error":"This group is archived — it is read-only"}
! http 403 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/deleteNote — {"error":"This group is archived — it is read-only"} + console.error AxiosError (nothing shown)
suggested_fix: Hide/disable write controls when the group is archived; close or block open sessions on archive; always show the banner.

title: After deleting a group the admin lands on 'ADMINS ONLY' for a different group
steps: As Maya in Thursday Whist Admin tap Delete, type "Thursday Whist", tap "Delete Group".
expected: Go to the group list with a line confirming the group was deleted.
actual: The page stays on /admin, now headed "FAMILY TABLE" with "ADMINS ONLY — Only group admins can manage settings and members. Ask your group admin to promote you."
why_it_matters: It reads as an error right after a destructive action.
suggested_fix: Navigate to /home after delete (and after archive from the app admin) with a short confirmation.

title: The App Admin dashboard is drawn for signed-out visitors and ordinary users
steps: Signed out, open http://localhost:4606/app-admin.
As Dan (http://localhost:4606/app-admin?access_token=sbx-dan) open the same address.
expected: Sign-in page, or the same 404 an unknown address gets.
actual: The dashboard frame is shown with "Unauthorized" / "App admin only", the "Clean Orphans" button, the invite form, and under "APP ADMINS" the visitor's own name. Every action is refused (401/403), so nothing leaks.
why_it_matters: It advertises an admin area and lists a plain user under 'App admins'.
evidence: ! http 403 POST /api/apps/sandbox/runtime/users/invite-user — {"message":"Only app admins can invite users"}
suggested_fix: Check the role before rendering; redirect or show the 404 page.

title: Bids and tricks typed in are lost on reload until Lock Bids / Save Round
steps: As Maya start a round, mark a trump winner and suit, enter two bids.
Reload the page. Same on the results step after entering all four trick counts.
expected: The half-entered round comes back.
actual: All bids, the trump mark and the trick counts are blank again.
why_it_matters: Phones drop a background tab when someone checks a message mid-round.
evidence: Before reload: [4] 1. Maya | 5 | [5] NT / [6] 2. Omer | 1 — after reload: [4] 1. Maya | — | [5] · / [6] 2. Omer | — | [7] ·
suggested_fix: Keep the draft of the round in local storage until it is locked/saved.

title: Admin list shows stale data after Unclaim; deleting a note that is already gone fails silently
steps: As Maya in Admin tap Unclaim → Confirm on a claimed member.
As Dan, with Maya's profile open, have Maya (admin) delete Dan's note, then tap Delete on that note in Dan's stale page.
expected: The card drops the e-mail at once; the second case removes the note or says it is already deleted.
actual: The card reads "Unclaimed" but still shows the e-mail until a reload. The stale delete returns 404 "Note not found", logs a console error, and the note stays on screen with no message.
why_it_matters: Small, but it makes the admin doubt the unclaim worked.
evidence: ! http 404 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/deleteNote — {"error":"Note not found"} + ! console.error AxiosError: Request failed with status code 404
suggested_fix: Refresh the member from the server response; treat 404 on delete as success and drop the note.

title: A plain player cannot fix a wrongly scored round and is not told who can
steps: As Maya in Family Table (plain player) score a round, then look at it on the session page and at /round/<id>.
expected: Either an edit option, or a line such as "Wrong score? A group admin can edit this round."
actual: The round card is plain text with no control; the round page is read-only with no explanation. Admins get "Edit round".
why_it_matters: The person holding the phone is often not the admin; a typo stays in the standings.
evidence: Round page as player: controls are only [3] button "Session" and the tab bar
suggested_fix: Add the hint for non-admins (or allow editing the latest round of an open session).

title: Tied players are given different ranks
steps: Score a round where two players get the same total (e.g. two made zero bids, +25 each) and read the session standings.
expected: Equal totals share a rank (2, 2, 4) or are marked as tied.
actual: Maya +25 is #2 and אמא +25 is #3; in another session Omer, Rachel and אבי, all on 0, are #3, #4, #5.
why_it_matters: Bragging rights are the point of the standings.
suggested_fix: Use competition ranking for equal totals.

title: '▲ this session' on the group page shows a closed session's numbers
steps: As newbie/Maya open Family Table when it has no open session.
Or in Thursday Whist: with an open session, read the small arrows next to the totals.
expected: No arrows when no session is open; with one open, the arrows are that session's totals (or the label says 'last session').
actual: Family Table with no open session shows +105 / +34 / +59 / +45 under the label "overall score · ▲ this session". In Thursday Whist the arrows kept showing the closed "Midweek special" while a different session was open.
why_it_matters: The label promises live numbers for tonight.
suggested_fix: Label it 'last session' when the session is closed; pick the open session when there is one.

title: Round entry on a 320 px phone: the number pad is below the fold and the step title is cut to 'R…'
steps: Set the viewport to 320x568, start a round, look at the bidding step, then the results step.
expected: Players and number pad visible together; full step title.
actual: Bidding: the four player rows fill the screen and the 0-13 pad needs a scroll, after which the rows are out of view. Results: the banner reads "R…" instead of "RESULTS".
why_it_matters: Small phones exist at every table; this is the screen used most.
suggested_fix: Tighten the player rows at small heights or pin the pad; let the banner wrap instead of truncating the title.

title: Controls with no accessible name
steps: Read the control list of the group header, the Admin page and the results step with a screen reader (or the review tool's listing).
expected: Every control has a name and toggles expose their state.
actual: The back arrow in the group header, the copy-code button, the rename check/cancel buttons, the rules send button and all switches are listed as "(no label)"; the RENEGE toggle exposes no pressed state.
why_it_matters: Screen-reader users cannot tell these buttons apart.
evidence: [29] button (no label) icon=check / [30] button (no label) icon=x
[8] switch (no label) near="ADVANCED RULES BY DEFAULT Highest bidde…" off
suggested_fix: Add aria-label to icon buttons, label the switches, aria-pressed on RENEGE.

title: No way to leave a group; an e-mail account is called 'User' and cannot be edited
steps: As a plain player look for 'Leave group' on the group list, group profile, menu and My Account.
Sign up with e-mail and open Menu → My Account.
expected: A leave option for members; a name (or at least the e-mail) as the account title and a way to change the password.
actual: No leave control anywhere; only an admin can remove you. My Account shows the name "User" with the e-mail and a Sign Out button, nothing else.
why_it_matters: People who joined the wrong group, or the wrong player, have to ask an admin.
suggested_fix: Add 'Leave group' (keeps history as an unclaimed player) and basic account editing.

title: Save Round does not notice that the bids changed under you
steps: Maya and Dan both open the same round in play (results step, נועה bid 5).
Maya types the tricks but does not save. Dan taps "Edit bids", changes נועה to 2, "Save Bids".
Maya taps "Save Round".
expected: Maya is told the bids changed and sees them before the score is stored.
actual: The round is saved against Dan's bids: Maya's screen showed bid 5, the stored line is "bid 2 · won 4 | -20". (The sandbox has no live updates, so in the real app Maya's screen may refresh by itself; the server check is still missing.) A second, later Save Round is refused correctly with "This round has already been scored".
why_it_matters: A score nobody at the table agreed to.
evidence: After Maya's save: נועה♥ | bid 2 · won 4 | -20 (her screen: [11] button "נועה bid 5 RENEGE —")
! http 409 POST /api/apps/sandbox/functions/saveRoundResults — {"error":"This round has already been scored"}
suggested_fix: Send the bids (or a version) with Save Round and refuse on mismatch.

title: Create Group has no server-side guard against a duplicate request
steps: As newbie open Create Group, fill both names.
Fire two clicks on "Create Group" in the same instant (script: btn.click(); btn.click()).
expected: One group.
actual: Two identical groups. With a real double tap (300 ms apart, slow network simulated) the button is already disabled ("Creating...") and only one group is made, so a finger cannot do this; a retry after a network timeout could.
why_it_matters: Low risk; noted for completeness.
evidence: [5] button "W WWWW…W Admin" / [6] button "W WWWW…W Admin" (two groups) after the same-tick double click
300 ms double tap: second tap saw "disabled text=Creating..."
suggested_fix: Disable on submit synchronously (ref, not state) or make creation idempotent.
